; Program: Find min positive and max negative among 10 integers from input.txt
; Assembler: TASM/MASM (16-bit), model tiny, .COM program (ORG 100h)
; Environment: DOS, uses only INT 21h
; Behavior:
;   - Opens "input.txt" in current directory
;   - Parses exactly 10 signed 16-bit decimal integers (spaces/newlines/tabs as separators, optional + or -)
;   - Clamps overflow to [-32768..32767]
;   - Finds:
;       * Minimum strictly positive (>0) element and its 1-based position
;       * Maximum strictly negative (<0) element and its 1-based position
;   - If not found, index is 0
;   - Prints:
;       MinPosIndex: X
;       MaxNegIndex: Y
; Notes:
;   - Uses a simple buffered read loop until 10 numbers parsed or EOF
;   - No 32-bit instructions; 8086-compatible

.286
.model tiny
.code
org 100h

start:
    ; Set DS = CS for .COM program
    push cs
    pop  ds

    ; Initialize state
    mov  [numCount], 0          ; numbers parsed
    mov  [bufPos], 0
    mov  [bufEnd], 0
    mov  [eofFlag], 0

    mov  word ptr [minPosVal], 7FFFh  ; sentinel: +32767 (largest positive)
    mov  word ptr [minPosIdx], 0      ; 0 = not found
    mov  word ptr [maxNegVal], 8000h  ; sentinel: -32768 (most negative)
    mov  word ptr [maxNegIdx], 0

    mov  [curIndex], 1          ; 1-based position as we parse

    ; Open "input.txt" for read-only
    mov  dx, OFFSET fileName
    mov  ax, 3D00h              ; open existing, read-only
    int  21h
    jc   open_fail
    mov  [hFile], ax

read_loop:
    ; If already have 10 numbers, done with reading content
    cmp  [numCount], 10
    jae  parse_done

    ; Ensure there is at least one byte in buffer, unless EOF
    cmp  [bufPos], [bufEnd]
    jb   have_byte
    ; Need to refill buffer
    cmp  [eofFlag], 0
    jne  parse_done              ; EOF and buffer empty => stop
    call refill_buffer
    jc   parse_done              ; read error treated as EOF/stop
    jmp  read_loop

have_byte:
    ; Skip whitespace (space, tab, CR, LF)
    mov  al, [buffer + 0]       ; dummy to fix MASM "assume" - we will index via SI
    ; Set SI = bufPos
    mov  si, [bufPos]
skip_ws:
    cmp  si, [bufEnd]
    jae  need_more_for_token
    mov  al, [buffer + si]
    cmp  al, ' '
    je   inc_si_ws
    cmp  al, 9                  ; TAB
    je   inc_si_ws
    cmp  al, 13                 ; CR
    je   inc_si_ws
    cmp  al, 10                 ; LF
    je   inc_si_ws
    jmp  token_start_found
inc_si_ws:
    inc  si
    jmp  skip_ws

need_more_for_token:
    ; Refill if possible
    mov  [bufPos], si
    cmp  [eofFlag], 0
    jne  parse_done
    call refill_buffer
    jc   parse_done
    jmp  read_loop

token_start_found:
    ; At start of token: optional '+' or '-'
    mov  [bufPos], si
    ; Parse signed 16-bit with clamping
    call parse_int16_clamped
    ; If carry set => need more data but EOF => stop; if no more and no digits read, skip one char
    ; parse routine returns:
    ;   AX = parsed value
    ;   CF=0 success, CF=1 and ZF=1 => need more data (hit buffer end mid-number)
    ;   CF=1 and ZF=0 => no digits consumed; advance one char and continue
    jnc  got_value
    jz   need_more_for_token     ; need more bytes (refill done inside when needed)
    ; no digits consumed; advance one byte and continue
    mov  si, [bufPos]
    inc  si
    mov  [bufPos], si
    jmp  read_loop

got_value:
    ; AX holds the parsed clamped int16
    ; Update min positive and max negative with current index
    mov  dx, ax                 ; DX = value
    cmp  dx, 0
    jle  check_negative
    ; positive > 0: check if less than current minPosVal
    mov  bx, [minPosVal]
    cmp  dx, bx
    jge  pos_done
    ; update
    mov  [minPosVal], dx
    mov  ax, [curIndex]
    mov  [minPosIdx], ax
pos_done:
    jmp  after_update

check_negative:
    cmp  dx, 0
    jge  after_update
    ; negative < 0: check if greater than current maxNegVal
    mov  bx, [maxNegVal]
    cmp  dx, bx
    jle  neg_done
    ; update
    mov  [maxNegVal], dx
    mov  ax, [curIndex]
    mov  [maxNegIdx], ax
neg_done:

after_update:
    ; Increment counters/index
    mov  al, [numCount]
    inc  al
    mov  [numCount], al
    mov  ax, [curIndex]
    inc  ax
    mov  [curIndex], ax
    jmp  read_loop

parse_done:
    ; Close file if opened
    mov  bx, [hFile]
    cmp  bx, -1
    je   after_close
    mov  ah, 3Eh
    int  21h
after_close:

    ; Output results:
    ; Line1: "MinPosIndex: X"
    mov  dx, OFFSET msgMin
    mov  cx, SIZEOF msgMin-1    ; exclude terminating 0
    call write_str_fixed

    mov  ax, [minPosIdx]
    call print_int16u           ; indices are non-negative; print as unsigned decimal

    ; newline
    mov  dx, OFFSET crlf
    mov  cx, 2
    call write_str_fixed

    ; Line2: "MaxNegIndex: Y"
    mov  dx, OFFSET msgMax
    mov  cx, SIZEOF msgMax-1
    call write_str_fixed

    mov  ax, [maxNegIdx]
    call print_int16u

    mov  dx, OFFSET crlf
    mov  cx, 2
    call write_str_fixed

    ; Exit to DOS
    mov  ax, 4C00h
    int  21h

open_fail:
    ; On open failure, print zeros as indices as per spec (no crash)
    mov  [minPosIdx], 0
    mov  [maxNegIdx], 0
    jmp  after_close

;---------------------------------------------
; Subroutines
;---------------------------------------------

; refill_buffer:
;   Reads next chunk into buffer, resets bufPos=0, bufEnd=bytesRead.
;   Sets eofFlag if bytesRead==0.
;   Preserves nothing significant.
;   On error CF=1, else CF=0.
refill_buffer PROC NEAR
    push ax
    push bx
    push cx
    push dx

    mov  bx, [hFile]
    mov  dx, OFFSET buffer
    mov  cx, BUF_SIZE
    mov  ah, 3Fh
    int  21h
    jc   rb_err
    ; AX = bytes read
    mov  [bufPos], 0
    mov  [bufEnd], ax
    cmp  ax, 0
    jne  rb_ok
    mov  [eofFlag], 1
rb_ok:
    clc
    jmp  rb_exit
rb_err:
    stc
rb_exit:
    pop  dx
    pop  cx
    pop  bx
    pop  ax
    ret
refill_buffer ENDP

; parse_int16_clamped:
;   Parses a signed 16-bit integer from current buffer position.
;   Skips optional '+' or '-' only if followed by at least one digit.
;   On success:
;       AX = clamped value [-32768..32767]
;       CF=0
;       bufPos advanced to first non-digit after the number.
;   On need-more-data (hit end-of-buffer in middle of token and EOF not yet reached):
;       CF=1, ZF=1 (caller should refill and retry)
;   On no digits at current position:
;       CF=1, ZF=0 (caller should advance one and continue)
parse_int16_clamped PROC NEAR
    push bx
    push cx
    push dx
    push si
    push di

    mov  si, [bufPos]
    mov  di, si                 ; di will walk
    ; Determine sign
    mov  bl, 0                  ; bl=0 positive, 1 negative
    mov  al, [buffer + di]
    cmp  al, '+'
    je   saw_sign
    cmp  al, '-'
    jne  check_digit
saw_sign:
    mov  bh, al                 ; remember sign char in BH
    inc  di
    ; Need to ensure next is a digit; if at end, signal need more
    cmp  di, [bufEnd]
    jae  need_more
    mov  al, [buffer + di]
    cmp  al, '0'
    jb   no_digits
    cmp  al, '9'
    ja   no_digits
    cmp  bh, '-'
    jne  check_digit
    mov  bl, 1                  ; negative
    jmp  check_digit

check_digit:
    mov  cx, 0                  ; digit count
    mov  ax, 0                  ; accumulator (unsigned)
parse_loop:
    cmp  di, [bufEnd]
    jae  maybe_more
    mov  dl, [buffer + di]
    cmp  dl, '0'
    jb   end_digits
    cmp  dl, '9'
    ja   end_digits
    ; digit => accumulate: ax = ax*10 + (dl-'0'), with clamp later
    ; multiply ax by 10: ax*8 + ax*2
    mov  bx, ax
    shl  ax, 1                  ; ax*2
    mov  dx, bx
    shl  dx, 3                  ; bx*8 in dx
    add  ax, dx                 ; ax = 10*old
    ; add digit
    mov  dh, 0
    mov  bl, dl
    sub  bl, '0'
    add  ax, bx                 ; add digit value (bx low byte)
    ; Track potential overflow by clamping later with sign
    inc  di
    inc  cx
    jmp  parse_loop

maybe_more:
    ; Reached end of current buffer while parsing digits (if we consumed any)
    cmp  cx, 0
    je   need_more              ; we were at a sign or non-digit at EOB
    ; We have digits but EOB; if not EOF, signal need more
    cmp  [eofFlag], 0
    jne  end_digits             ; EOF reached; finalize
    ; need more data
need_more:
    ; Request more data
    ; Update bufPos to current DI before returning
    mov  [bufPos], di
    stc
    ; CF=1, ZF=1 denote need more
    push ax
    xor  ax, ax
    cmp  ax, ax                 ; set ZF=1
    pop  ax
    jmp  parse_exit

no_digits:
    ; No digits at current position (including sign not followed by digit)
    mov  [bufPos], si
    stc
    ; CF=1, ZF=0
    push ax
    mov  ax, 1
    cmp  ax, 2                  ; set ZF=0
    pop  ax
    jmp  parse_exit

end_digits:
    ; We have CX = digits consumed (may be zero if first char wasn't digit)
    cmp  cx, 0
    jne  have_number
    ; No digits consumed -> report no_digits
    mov  [bufPos], si
    stc
    push ax
    mov  ax, 1
    cmp  ax, 2
    pop  ax
    jmp  parse_exit

have_number:
    ; Apply sign with clamping to int16
    ; Current AX holds absolute value accumulated (may exceed 32767)
    ; Clamp abs to 32768 for negative, 32767 for positive
    cmp  bl, 0
    jne  do_negative
    ; positive
    cmp  ax, 32767
    jbe  pos_ok
    mov  ax, 32767
pos_ok:
    jmp  store_and_ret
do_negative:
    ; negative: allow -32768
    cmp  ax, 32768/1            ; MASM/TASM accept 32768 as immediate?
    ; Since immediate 32768 doesn't fit unsigned 16, use 8000h
    ; Adjust: compare to 8000h
    cmp  ax, 8000h
    jbe  neg_ok
    mov  ax, 8000h
neg_ok:
    ; produce two's complement negative: if ax=8000h => remains 8000h after neg? No, NEG 8000h = 8000h
    ; We need AX = -abs => two's complement of AX
    neg  ax
store_and_ret:
    ; Advance buffer position to DI (we stopped at first non-digit)
    mov  [bufPos], di
    clc
parse_exit:
    pop  di
    pop  si
    pop  dx
    pop  cx
    pop  bx
    ret
parse_int16_clamped ENDP

; write_str_fixed:
;   Writes CX bytes from DS:DX to stdout.
;   Destroys AX, BX, DX.
write_str_fixed PROC NEAR
    push ax
    push bx
    push dx
    push cx
    mov  bx, 1                  ; stdout handle
    mov  ah, 40h
    int  21h
    pop  cx
    pop  dx
    pop  bx
    pop  ax
    ret
write_str_fixed ENDP

; print_int16u:
;   Prints unsigned 16-bit in AX as decimal without leading zeros.
;   If AX=0, prints single '0'.
;   Uses a small temporary buffer in decBuf (max 5 digits needed for 0..65535).
print_int16u PROC NEAR
    push ax
    push bx
    push cx
    push dx
    push si

    mov  bx, 10
    mov  cx, 0
    cmp  ax, 0
    jne  piu_loop
    mov  byte ptr [decBuf], '0'
    mov  cx, 1
    jmp  piu_out

piu_loop:
    ; Repeatedly divide by 10, store remainders
    xor  dx, dx
    div  bx             ; AX=AX/10, DX=AX%10
    add  dl, '0'
    mov  [decBuf + cx], dl
    inc  cx
    cmp  ax, 0
    jne  piu_loop

piu_out:
    ; Output digits in reverse
    mov  si, cx
    jcxz piu_done
piu_rev:
    dec  si
    mov  dl, [decBuf + si]
    mov  ah, 02h
    int  21h
    loop piu_rev

piu_done:
    pop  si
    pop  dx
    pop  cx
    pop  bx
    pop  ax
    ret
print_int16u ENDP

;---------------------------------------------
; Data
;---------------------------------------------
hFile       dw  -1
numCount    db  0
curIndex    dw  0
minPosVal   dw  0
minPosIdx   dw  0
maxNegVal   dw  0
maxNegIdx   dw  0
eofFlag     db  0
bufPos      dw  0
bufEnd      dw  0

fileName    db 'input.txt',0
msgMin      db 'MinPosIndex: ',0
msgMax      db 'MaxNegIndex: ',0
crlf        db 13,10

BUF_SIZE    EQU 256
buffer      db BUF_SIZE dup(?)
decBuf      db 6 dup(?)       ; enough for up to 5 digits plus safety

END start

    jge     after_update
    ; dx < 0
    ; If first negative (maxneg_pos==0) or dx > maxneg_val then update
    mov     ax, [maxneg_pos]
    or      ax, ax
    jnz     cmp_maxneg
    ; first negative
    mov     [maxneg_val], dx
    mov     [maxneg_pos], di
    jmp     after_update
cmp_maxneg:
    mov     ax, [maxneg_val]
    cmp     dx, ax
    jle     after_update
    mov     [maxneg_val], dx
    mov     [maxneg_pos], di

after_update:
    ; Continue parsing next number (skip trailing spaces)
    jmp     skip_ws

parsing_done:
    ; Done parsing, either buffer ended or reached 10 numbers

    ; If no positive found (pos==0), value must be 0 per requirement
    mov     ax, [minpos_pos]
    or      ax, ax
    jnz     pos_ok
    mov     word ptr [minpos_val], 0
pos_ok:
    ; If no negative found (pos==0), value must be 0
    mov     ax, [maxneg_pos]
    or      ax, ax
    jnz     neg_ok
    mov     word ptr [maxneg_val], 0
neg_ok:

    ; Prepare and print output lines
    ; Line 1: "Min+ value: <value> pos: <pos>\r\n"
    mov     ax, [minpos_val]
    mov     bx, offset out_num1
    call    itoa_signed_16      ; writes AX as signed decimal to $-terminated field
    mov     ax, [minpos_pos]
    mov     bx, offset out_pos1
    call    itoa_unsigned_16
    mov     dx, offset out_line1
    mov     ah, 09h
    int     21h

    ; Line 2: "Max- value: <value> pos: <pos>\r\n"
    mov     ax, [maxneg_val]
    mov     bx, offset out_num2
    call    itoa_signed_16
    mov     ax, [maxneg_pos]
    mov     bx, offset out_pos2
    call    itoa_unsigned_16
    mov     dx, offset out_line2
    mov     ah, 09h
    int     21h

read_done:
    ; Exit to DOS
    mov     ax, 4C00h
    int     21h

; -----------------------------
; itoa_unsigned_16
; In:  AX = unsigned value (0..65535)
;      BX = pointer to destination field (ASCII, terminated by '$' after write)
; Out: Writes decimal ASCII digits, no leading spaces, at least "0".
;      Places '$' after the number and null-terminates by writing '$'.
; Clobbers: AX, BX, CX, DX, SI, DI
; -----------------------------
itoa_unsigned_16:
    push    ax
    push    bx
    push    cx
    push    dx
    push    si
    push    di

    mov     si, bx             ; si = dest
    ; Special case 0
    cmp     ax, 0
    jne     iu_nonzero
    mov     byte ptr [si], '0'
    inc     si
    mov     byte ptr [si], 0    ; place temporary 0 (we’ll replace with '$')
    jmp     iu_finish

iu_nonzero:
    ; Convert by repeated div by 10, store digits reversed on stack buffer
    mov     di, offset revbuf   ; use revbuf as temporary storage
    mov     cx, 0
iu_loop:
    xor     dx, dx
    mov     bx, 10
    div     bx                  ; AX = AX/10, DX = remainder
    add     dl, '0'
    mov     [di], dl
    inc     di
    inc     cx
    cmp     ax, 0
    jne     iu_loop

    ; Output in correct order
    ; di points past last stored digit, cx = count
    sub     di, 1
iu_out:
    mov     dl, [di]
    mov     [si], dl
    inc     si
    dec     di
    loop    iu_out
    mov     byte ptr [si], 0    ; temporary 0

iu_finish:
    ; Replace temporary 0 with '$' to make AH=09h-friendly substrings
    mov     byte ptr [si], '$'

    pop     di
    pop     si
    pop     dx
    pop     cx
    pop     bx
    pop     ax
    ret

; -----------------------------
; itoa_signed_16
; In:  AX = signed value (-32768..32767)
;      BX = destination field, will be '$'-terminated
; Uses itoa_unsigned_16 for magnitude. Handles -32768 correctly.
; Clobbers: AX, BX, CX, DX, SI, DI
; -----------------------------
itoa_signed_16:
    push    ax
    push    bx

    ; Check sign
    cmp     ax, 0
    jge     is_nonneg

    ; Negative: handle -32768 carefully
    ; We'll print '-' then magnitude of -(AX), using 16-bit handling
    ; Compute magnitude = 0 - AX (unsigned)
    mov     dx, 0
    sub     dx, ax              ; DX = -AX as unsigned (works for -32768 -> 32768 in DX)
    ; Write '-' at dest
    mov     si, bx
    mov     byte ptr [si], '-'
    inc     si
    ; Convert DX (unsigned magnitude up to 32768) with unsigned routine
    mov     ax, dx
    mov     bx, si
    call    itoa_unsigned_16
    ; Done
    pop     bx
    pop     ax
    ret

is_nonneg:
    ; Non-negative: just convert AX as unsigned
    mov     bx, bx              ; dest already in BX
    call    itoa_unsigned_16
    pop     bx
    pop     ax
    ret

; -----------------------------
; Data
; -----------------------------
fname       db 'input.txt',0

; Input buffer and bookkeeping
inbuf_size  equ 1024
inbuf       db inbuf_size dup(?)
inlen       dw 0
hFile       dw 0

; Results
minpos_val  dw ?
minpos_pos  dw ?
maxneg_val  dw ?
maxneg_pos  dw ?

; Temporary buffer for reversed digits
revbuf      db 6 dup(0)    ; enough for 65535 (5 digits) plus slack

; Output templates (placeholders replaced before printing)
; We'll store number substrings inline and ensure they end with '$' for AH=09h.

out_line1   db 'Min+ value: '
out_num1    db '$'              ; number goes here (replaced before print)
            db ' pos: '
out_pos1    db '$'
            db 13,10,'$'        ; CR LF and terminator for AH=09h

out_line2   db 'Max- value: '
out_num2    db '$'
            db ' pos: '
out_pos2    db '$'
            db 13,10,'$'

; Small temporary variable used in earlier (abandoned) code path
si_tmp      dw 0

; Stack
stack_size  equ 256
stack_area  db stack_size dup(0)
stack_top   label word

end start

import os
import sqlite3
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, messagebox

# Matplotlib for data visualization (embedded in Tkinter)
from matplotlib.backends.backend_tkagg import FigureCanvasTkAgg
from matplotlib.figure import Figure

DB_FILE = "app_inventory.db"


class Database:
    """Simple SQLite helper for the sample GUI app."""

    def __init__(self, db_file=DB_FILE):
        self.db_file = db_file
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_file)
        self.conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.ensure_schema_and_seed()

    def ensure_schema_and_seed(self):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                category TEXT NOT NULL,
                price REAL NOT NULL,
                quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
            """
        )
        self.conn.commit()

        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM products")
        count = cur.fetchone()["c"]
        if count == 0:
            # Seed with at least 10 records across multiple categories
            sample = [
                ("USB-C Cable", "Electronics", 9.99, 120),
                ("Wireless Mouse", "Electronics", 24.50, 60),
                ("Notebook A5", "Stationery", 3.49, 200),
                ("Ballpoint Pen", "Stationery", 1.20, 500),
                ("Cotton T-Shirt", "Clothing", 12.99, 80),
                ("Jeans", "Clothing", 39.99, 45),
                ("Coffee Beans 1kg", "Groceries", 14.99, 35),
                ("Olive Oil 1L", "Groceries", 10.50, 40),
                ("Novel: The Odyssey", "Books", 8.99, 25),
                ("Cookbook: Quick Meals", "Books", 15.99, 18),
                ("LED Desk Lamp", "Electronics", 29.90, 30),
                ("Sketchbook A4", "Stationery", 6.75, 75),
            ]
            cur.executemany(
                "INSERT INTO products (name, category, price, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                sample,
            )
            self.conn.commit()

    def all_products(self):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "SELECT id, name, category, price, quantity FROM products ORDER BY id DESC"
        )
        return cur.fetchall()

    def search_products(self, term):
        like = f"%{term}%"
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT id, name, category, price, quantity
            FROM products
            WHERE name LIKE ? OR category LIKE ?
            ORDER BY id DESC
            """,
            (like, like),
        )
        return cur.fetchall()

    def insert_product(self, name, category, price, quantity):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO products (name, category, price, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (name, category, price, quantity),
        )
        self.conn.commit()
        return cur.lastrowid

    def update_product(self, pid, name, category, price, quantity):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            UPDATE products
            SET name = ?, category = ?, price = ?, quantity = ?
            WHERE id = ?
            """,
            (name, category, price, quantity, pid),
        )
        self.conn.commit()

    def delete_product(self, pid):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM products WHERE id = ?", (pid,))
        self.conn.commit()

    def aggregates_by_category(self):
        """Return list of (category, total_qty, total_value)."""
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT
                category,
                SUM(quantity) AS total_qty,
                SUM(price * quantity) AS total_value
            FROM products
            GROUP BY category
            ORDER BY category
            """
        )
        return cur.fetchall()

    def close(self):
        self.conn.close()


class DatabaseWindow(tk.Toplevel):

    # ----- Callbacks and helpers -----

    def load_data(self):
        """Load all products into the tree."""
        for item in self.tree.get_children():
            self.tree.delete(item)

        rows = self.db.all_products()
        for r in rows:
            self.tree.insert(
                "",

import os
import sqlite3
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, messagebox

# Matplotlib for data visualization (embedded in Tkinter)
from matplotlib.backends.backend_tkagg import FigureCanvasTkAgg
from matplotlib.figure import Figure

DB_FILE = "app_inventory.db"
LOGO_FILE = "logo.png"


def resource_path(filename):
    """Resolve a resource path relative to the script location."""
    base = os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(__file__)) if "__file__" in globals() else os.getcwd()
    return os.path.join(base, filename)


class Database:
    """Simple SQLite helper for the sample GUI app."""

    def __init__(self, db_file=DB_FILE):
        self.db_file = db_file
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_file)
        self.conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.ensure_schema_and_seed()

    def ensure_schema_and_seed(self):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                category TEXT NOT NULL,
                price REAL NOT NULL,
                quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
            """
        )
        self.conn.commit()

        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM products")
        count = cur.fetchone()["c"]
        if count == 0:
            # Seed with at least 10 records across multiple categories
            sample = [
                ("USB-C Cable", "Electronics", 9.99, 120),
                ("Wireless Mouse", "Electronics", 24.50, 60),
                ("Notebook A5", "Stationery", 3.49, 200),
                ("Ballpoint Pen", "Stationery", 1.20, 500),
                ("Cotton T-Shirt", "Clothing", 12.99, 80),
                ("Jeans", "Clothing", 39.99, 45),
                ("Coffee Beans 1kg", "Groceries", 14.99, 35),
                ("Olive Oil 1L", "Groceries", 10.50, 40),
                ("Novel: The Odyssey", "Books", 8.99, 25),
                ("Cookbook: Quick Meals", "Books", 15.99, 18),
                ("LED Desk Lamp", "Electronics", 29.90, 30),
                ("Sketchbook A4", "Stationery", 6.75, 75),
            ]
            cur.executemany(
                "INSERT INTO products (name, category, price, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                sample,
            )
            self.conn.commit()

    def all_products(self):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "SELECT id, name, category, price, quantity FROM products ORDER BY id DESC"
        )
        return cur.fetchall()

    def search_products(self, term):
        like = f"%{term}%"
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT id, name, category, price, quantity
            FROM products
            WHERE name LIKE ? OR category LIKE ?
            ORDER BY id DESC
            """,
            (like, like),
        )
        return cur.fetchall()

    def insert_product(self, name, category, price, quantity):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO products (name, category, price, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (name, category, price, quantity),
        )
        self.conn.commit()
        return cur.lastrowid

    def update_product(self, pid, name, category, price, quantity):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            UPDATE products
            SET name = ?, category = ?, price = ?, quantity = ?
            WHERE id = ?
            """,
            (name, category, price, quantity, pid),
        )
        self.conn.commit()

    def delete_product(self, pid):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM products WHERE id = ?", (pid,))
        self.conn.commit()

    def aggregates_by_category(self):
        """Return list of (category, total_qty, total_value)."""
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT
                category,
                SUM(quantity) AS total_qty,
                SUM(price * quantity) AS total_value
            FROM products
            GROUP BY category
            ORDER BY category
            """
        )
        return cur.fetchall()

    def close(self):
        self.conn.close()

def resource_path(filename):
    """Resolve a resource path relative to the script location or current working directory."""
    base = os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(__file__)) if "__file__" in globals() else os.getcwd()

class Database:
    """Simple SQLite helper for the sample GUI app."""

    def __init__(self, db_file=DB_FILE):
        self.db_file = db_file
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_file)
        self.conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.ensure_schema_and_seed()

    def ensure_schema_and_seed(self):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                category TEXT NOT NULL,
                price REAL NOT NULL,
                quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
            """
        )
        self.conn.commit()

        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM products")
        count = cur.fetchone()["c"]
        if count == 0:
            # Seed with at least 10 records across multiple categories
            sample = [
                ("USB-C Cable", "Electronics", 9.99, 120),
                ("Wireless Mouse", "Electronics", 24.50, 60),
                ("Notebook A5", "Stationery", 3.49, 200),
                ("Ballpoint Pen", "Stationery", 1.20, 500),
                ("Cotton T-Shirt", "Clothing", 12.99, 80),
                ("Jeans", "Clothing", 39.99, 45),
                ("Coffee Beans 1kg", "Groceries", 14.99, 35),
                ("Olive Oil 1L", "Groceries", 10.50, 40),
                ("Novel: The Odyssey", "Books", 8.99, 25),
                ("Cookbook: Quick Meals", "Books", 15.99, 18),
                ("LED Desk Lamp", "Electronics", 29.90, 30),
                ("Sketchbook A4", "Stationery", 6.75, 75),
            ]
            cur.executemany(
                "INSERT INTO products (name, category, price, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                sample,
            )
            self.conn.commit()

    def all_products(self):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "SELECT id, name, category, price, quantity FROM products ORDER BY id DESC"
        )
        return cur.fetchall()

    def search_products(self, term):
        like = f"%{term}%"
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT id, name, category, price, quantity
            FROM products
            WHERE name LIKE ? OR category LIKE ?
            ORDER BY id DESC
            """,
            (like, like),
        )
        return cur.fetchall()

    def insert_product(self, name, category, price, quantity):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO products (name, category, price, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (name, category, price, quantity),
        )
        self.conn.commit()
        return cur.lastrowid

    def update_product(self, pid, name, category, price, quantity):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            UPDATE products
            SET name = ?, category = ?, price = ?, quantity = ?
            WHERE id = ?
            """,
            (name, category, price, quantity, pid),
        )
        self.conn.commit()

    def delete_product(self, pid):
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM products WHERE id = ?", (pid,))
        self.conn.commit()

    def aggregates_by_category(self):
        """Return list of rows with category, total_qty, total_value."""
        cur = self.conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT
                category,
                SUM(quantity) AS total_qty,
                SUM(price * quantity) AS total_value
            FROM products
            GROUP BY category
            ORDER BY category
            """
        )
        return cur.fetchall()

    def close(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def load_data(self):
        """Load all products into the tree and clear search."""
        # Clear tree
        for item in self.tree.get_children():
            self.tree.delete(item)

        # Populate rows
        try:
            rows = self.db.all_products()
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Database Error", f"Failed to load products:\n{e}", parent=self)
            rows = []

        for r in rows:
            self.tree.insert(
                "",
                "end",
                iid=str(r["id"]),
                values=(r["id"], r["name"], r["category"], f"{r['price']:.2f}", r["quantity"]),
            )

        # Reset UI state
        self.search_var.set("")
        self.clear_form(keep_category=True)

    def on_search(self):
        """Search by term (name or category)."""
        term = self.search_var.get().strip()

        # Clear tree
        for item in self.tree.get_children():
            self.tree.delete(item)

        # Query
        try:
            rows = self.db.search_products(term) if term else self.db.all_products()
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Database Error", f"Search failed:\n{e}", parent=self)
            rows = []

        # Populate
        for r in rows:
            self.tree.insert(
                "",
                "end",
                iid=str(r["id"]),
                values=(r["id"], r["name"], r["category"], f"{r['price']:.2f}", r["quantity"]),
            )

        # Clear selection and form so user knows they're in a filtered set
        self.clear_form(keep_category=True)

    def on_tree_select(self, event=None):
        """Populate form when a row is selected."""
        sel = self.tree.selection()
        if not sel:
            return
        iid = sel[0]
        vals = self.tree.item(iid, "values")
        try:
            pid, name, category, price, quantity = vals
        except Exception:
            return
        self.selected_id = int(pid)
        self.var_name.set(name)
        self.var_category.set(category)
        self.var_price.set(str(price))
        self.var_quantity.set(str(quantity))

    def _validate_inputs(self):
        """Validate form inputs; returns (ok, name, category, price, qty, error_msg)."""
        name = self.var_name.get().strip()
        category = self.var_category.get().strip()
        price_s = self.var_price.get().strip()
        qty_s = self.var_quantity.get().strip()

        if not name:
            return False, None, None, None, None, "Name is required."
        if not category:
            return False, None, None, None, None, "Category is required."
        try:
            price = float(price_s)
            if price < 0:
                return False, None, None, None, None, "Price must be non-negative."
        except ValueError:
            return False, None, None, None, None, "Price must be a valid number."
        try:
            qty = int(qty_s)
            if qty < 0:
                return False, None, None, None, None, "Quantity must be non-negative."
        except ValueError:
            return False, None, None, None, None, "Quantity must be an integer."
        return True, name, category, price, qty, None

    def clear_form(self, keep_category=False):
        """Reset form fields and selection."""
        self.selected_id = None
        self.var_name.set("")
        if not keep_category and self.CATEGORIES:
            self.var_category.set(self.CATEGORIES[0])
        self.var_price.set("")
        self.var_quantity.set("")
        for sel in self.tree.selection():
            self.tree.selection_remove(sel)

    def add_product(self):
        ok, name, category, price, qty, err = self._validate_inputs()
        if not ok:
            messagebox.showwarning("Invalid Input", err, parent=self)
            return
        try:
            self.db.insert_product(name, category, price, qty)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Database Error", f"Failed to add product:\n{e}", parent=self)
            return
        # Refresh and reset
        self.load_data()
        self.clear_form()

    def update_product(self):
        if self.selected_id is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("No Selection", "Select a product to update.", parent=self)
            return
        ok, name, category, price, qty, err = self._validate_inputs()
        if not ok:
            messagebox.showwarning("Invalid Input", err, parent=self)
            return
        try:
            self.db.update_product(self.selected_id, name, category, price, qty)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Database Error", f"Failed to update product:\n{e}", parent=self)
            return
        self.load_data()
        self.clear_form()

    def delete_product(self):
        if self.selected_id is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("No Selection", "Select a product to delete.", parent=self)
            return
        if not messagebox.askyesno("Confirm Delete", "Are you sure you want to delete this product?", parent=self):
            return
        try:
            self.db.delete_product(self.selected_id)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Database Error", f"Failed to delete product:\n{e}", parent=self)
            return
        self.load_data()
        self.clear_form()

def replace_audio_in_video(
    video_path: str,
    audio_path: str,
    output_path: str,
    audio_bitrate: str = "192k",
    video_codec: str = "libx264",
    audio_codec: str = "aac",
    audio_fps: int = 44100,
    preset: str = "medium",
    crf: int = 23
) -> None:
    """
    Replace the audio track of video_path with audio_path.
    - Loops or trims the audio to match the video duration.
    - Saves to output_path, re-encoding video for compatibility.
    """
    print(f"[INFO] Processing video: {video_path}")
    print(f"[INFO] Using audio track: {audio_path}")

    video = None
    music = None
    final = None
    try:
        video = VideoFileClip(video_path)

        # Load audio and adapt to video duration
        music = AudioFileClip(audio_path)
        if music.duration < video.duration:
            print("[INFO] Audio is shorter than video; looping audio to match duration.")
            music = afx.audio_loop(music, duration=video.duration)
        elif music.duration > video.duration:
            print("[INFO] Audio is longer than video; trimming audio to match duration.")
            music = music.subclip(0, video.duration)

        # Remove original audio and set new one
        video_no_audio = video.without_audio()
        final = video_no_audio.set_audio(music)

        # Ensure output directory exists
        Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        # Write video with new audio
        # MoviePy uses ffmpeg under the hood
        print("[INFO] Writing output video (this may take a while)...")
        final.write_videofile(
            output_path,
            codec=video_codec,
            audio_codec=audio_codec,
            audio_bitrate=audio_bitrate,
            audio_fps=audio_fps,
            preset=preset,
            ffmpeg_params=["-crf", str(crf), "-movflags", "+faststart"]
        )
        print(f"[SUCCESS] Saved: {output_path}")
    finally:
        # Clean up resources
        try:
            if final:
                final.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            if video:
                video.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            if music:
                music.close()
        except Exception:
            pass


def get_youtube_service(client_secrets_path: str, token_path: Optional[str] = None):
    """
    Build and return an authenticated YouTube Data API client.
    Stores OAuth token locally for reuse.
    """
    client_secrets_path = str(Path(client_secrets_path).resolve())
    if not Path(client_secrets_path).exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"client_secrets.json not found at: {client_secrets_path}")

    if token_path is None:
        token_path = str(Path(client_secrets_path).with_name("youtube_token.pickle"))

    creds = None
    if Path(token_path).exists():
        with open(token_path, "rb") as f:
            creds = pickle.load(f)

    if not creds or not hasattr(creds, "valid") or not creds.valid:
        if creds and creds.expired and getattr(creds, "refresh_token", None):
            try:
                creds.refresh(Request())
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[WARN] Could not refresh token: {e}. Will run OAuth flow again.")
                creds = None
        if not creds or not getattr(creds, "valid", False):
            flow = InstalledAppFlow.from_client_secrets_file(client_secrets_path, YOUTUBE_SCOPES)
            creds = flow.run_local_server(port=0)
        with open(token_path, "wb") as f:
            pickle.dump(creds, f)
            print(f"[INFO] Saved OAuth token to: {token_path}")

    service = build("youtube", "v3", credentials=creds)
    return service

    response = None
    max_retries = 5
    retry = 0
    while response is None:
        try:
            status, response = request.next_chunk()
            if response is not None:
                if "id" in response:
                    print(f"[SUCCESS] Uploaded: https://studio.youtube.com/video/{response['id']}/edit")
                    return response["id"]
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected response: {response}")
        except HttpError as e:
            if e.resp.status in [500, 502, 503, 504] and retry < max_retries:
                sleep_s = (2 ** retry)
                print(f"[WARN] Retriable error {e.resp.status}. Sleeping {sleep_s}s and retrying...")
                time.sleep(sleep_s)
                retry += 1
                continue
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            if retry < max_retries:
                sleep_s = (2 ** retry)
                print(f"[WARN] Transient error: {e}. Sleeping {sleep_s}s and retrying...")
                time.sleep(sleep_s)
                retry += 1
                continue
            raise

    return ""


def find_videos_in_path(path: Path, extensions=(".mp4", ".mov", ".mkv", ".m4v", ".avi")) -> List[Path]:
    if path.is_file():
        return [path]
    found = []
    for ext in extensions:
        found.extend(path.rglob(f"*{ext}"))
    return sorted(found)


def default_output_name(input_path: Path, output_dir: Optional[Path]) -> Path:
    parent = output_dir if output_dir else input_path.parent
    stem = input_path.stem + "_replaced"
    return parent / f"{stem}.mp4"


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Replace audio in videos and upload privately to YouTube.")
    parser.add_argument("--input", required=True, help="Path to a video file or a folder with videos.")
    parser.add_argument("--audio", required=True, help="Path to the replacement audio file (will be looped/trimmed).")
    parser.add_argument("--client-secrets", required=True, help="Path to YouTube OAuth client_secrets.json.")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", default=None, help="Directory to place processed videos.")
    parser.add_argument("--title-template", default="{stem}", help="Title template. Use {stem} for filename without extension.")
    parser.add_argument("--description", default="Automated upload", help="YouTube description.")
    parser.add_argument("--tags", default="", help="Comma-separated tags, e.g., 'school,tournament,sports'.")
    parser.add_argument("--category", default="17", help="YouTube category ID (default 17 = Sports).")
    parser.add_argument("--made-for-kids", action="store_true", help="Mark videos as 'made for kids'.")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_path = Path(args.input).resolve()
    audio_path = Path(args.audio).resolve()
    client_secrets_path = Path(args.client_secrets).resolve()
    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir).resolve() if args.output_dir else None

    if not input_path.exists():
        print(f"[ERROR] Input path does not exist: {input_path}")
        sys.exit(1)
    if not audio_path.exists():
        print(f"[ERROR] Audio file does not exist: {audio_path}")
        sys.exit(1)
    if not client_secrets_path.exists():
        print(f"[ERROR] client_secrets.json not found: {client_secrets_path}")
        sys.exit(1)
    if output_dir:
        output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    videos = find_videos_in_path(input_path)
    if not videos:
        print(f"[ERROR] No videos found at: {input_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    tags_list = [t.strip() for t in args.tags.split(",") if t.strip()] if args.tags else []

    # Authenticate once
    try:
        youtube = get_youtube_service(str(client_secrets_path))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[ERROR] Failed to authenticate with YouTube API: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

    failures = 0
    for vid in videos:
        try:
            out_path = default_output_name(vid, output_dir)
            title = args.title_template.format(stem=vid.stem)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[WARN] Title template error ({e}); using default title.")
            out_path = default_output_name(vid, output_dir)
            title = vid.stem

        try:
            replace_audio_in_video(str(vid), str(audio_path), str(out_path))
        except Exception as e:
            failures += 1
            print(f"[ERROR] Failed processing {vid}: {e}")
            continue

        try:
            video_id = upload_video_private(
                youtube=youtube,
                file_path=str(out_path),
                title=title,
                description=args.description,
                tags=tags_list,
                category_id=str(args.category),
                made_for_kids=bool(args.made_for_kids),
            )
            print(f"[INFO] Video ID: {video_id} for file {out_path}")
        except Exception as e:
            failures += 1
            print(f"[ERROR] Failed uploading {out_path}: {e}")
            continue

    if failures:
        print(f"[DONE] Completed with {failures} failure(s).")
        sys.exit(2)
    else:
        print("[DONE] All videos processed and uploaded successfully.")
        sys.exit(0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

How to use this script

Prerequisites
- Install ffmpeg on your system and make sure it’s on your PATH.
- Install Python packages:
  - pip install moviepy google-api-python-client google-auth-oauthlib google-auth-httplib2
- Obtain a YouTube Data API OAuth client_secrets.json.

Getting client_secrets.json from Google Cloud
1) Go to Google Cloud Console and create or select a project.
2) In “APIs & Services” → “Library”, enable “YouTube Data API v3”.
3) In “APIs & Services” → “Credentials”, click “Create Credentials” → “OAuth client ID”.
4) Choose “Desktop app” as the application type and create it.
5) Click the download icon for the new client to get the JSON file; save it as client_secrets.json somewhere safe.

Running the OAuth flow the first time
- On your first run, the script opens a browser window prompting you to grant access to your Google account for YouTube uploads. After approval, the script saves a token file (youtube_token.pickle) next to client_secrets.json so you won’t have to log in again on subsequent runs.

Examples
- Single file:
  python3 script.py \
    --input /path/to/game1.mp4 \
    --audio /path/to/music.mp3 \
    --client-secrets /path/to/client_secrets.json \
    --output-dir /path/to/output \

    --description "Automated upload" \

% --------------------------------------------

    monthLength2023 : (month, integer) determ.
    dayOfYear2023 : (date, integer) determ.  % 1..365
clauses
    is2023Date(date(2023,M,D)) :-

predicates

% --------------------------------------------
% Time utilities

predicates
    timeToMinutes : (time, integer) determ.
    minutesToTime : (integer, time) determ.
    addMinutesClampDay : (time, integer, time) determ.  % clamp to 0..23:59
    minTimeOfTwo : (time, time, time) determ.
    maxTimeOfTwo : (time, time, time) determ.
    formatTimeHHMM : (time, string) determ.
    formatDateYYYYMMDD : (date, string) determ.
clauses
    timeToMinutes(time(H,M), T) :- T = H*60 + M.

    minutesToTime(T, time(H,M)) :-
        ( if T < 0 then TT = 0
          else if T > 23*60+59 then TT = 23*60+59
          else TT = T end if end if ),
        H = TT div 60,
        M = TT mod 60.

    addMinutesClampDay(T, Delta, T2) :-
        timeToMinutes(T, N),
        N2 = N + Delta,
        minutesToTime(N2, T2).

    minTimeOfTwo(A,B,Min) :-
        timeToMinutes(A, NA),
        timeToMinutes(B, NB),
        ( if NA =< NB then Min = A else Min = B end if ).

    maxTimeOfTwo(A,B,Max) :-
        timeToMinutes(A, NA),
        timeToMinutes(B, NB),
        ( if NA >= NB then Max = A else Max = B end if ).

    formatTimeHHMM(time(H,M), S) :-
        H1 = if H<10 then "0" & integer::toString(H) else integer::toString(H) end if,
        M1 = if M<10 then "0" & integer::toString(M) else integer::toString(M) end if,
        S = H1 & ":" & M1.

    formatDateYYYYMMDD(date(Y,Mo,Da), S) :-
        YS = integer::toString(Y),
        MS = if Mo<10 then "0" & integer::toString(Mo) else integer::toString(Mo) end if,
        DS = if Da<10 then "0" & integer::toString(Da) else integer::toString(Da) end if,
        S = YS & "-" & MS & "-" & DS.

% --------------------------------------------
% Synthetic generator for Cairo/Giza base times for every day of 2023
% The generator models a seasonal sinusoid-like drift with simple integer math:
% - We produce base Cairo times, then set Giza as Cairo +1 minute.
% - The remaining governorates derive from Cairo using govOffset.
% This keeps data deterministic and complete without external files.
% Note: These are illustrative times for the programming task (not for real use).
% --------------------------------------------
predicates
    genCairoDay : (date, time, time, time, time, time, time) determ.
    genGizaDay  : (date, time, time, time, time, time, time) determ.
clauses
    % Helper seasonal offset in minutes using day-of-year
    % Peak earliest around mid-June (~day 167), latest around mid-December.
    % We approximate with a triangular wave over the year for integer arithmetic.
    seasonalOffset(DOY, Offset) :-
        % Triangular wave from -15 to +15 over 365 days
        % map to [0, 730) and reflect
        P = 365,
        X = DOY mod P,
        % triangle t in [0..P): rises to P/2 then falls
        T1 = if X =< 182 then X else (P - 1 - X) end if,
        % Normalize to 0..182 then scale to -15..+15
        Offset = (T1*30) div 182 - 15.

    % Base anchor times near typical ranges (not accurate to almanacs):
    % Fajr ~ 05:10 winter -> 03:25 summer; Sunrise ~ +90; Dhuhr ~ 11:58..12:08; Asr ~ +4h; Maghrib ~ sunset ~ Sunrise + (12h approx) - small drift; Isha ~ ~ +1h30 after Maghrib
    genCairoDay(Date, Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) :-
        is2023Date(Date),
        dayOfYear2023(Date, DOY),
        seasonalOffset(DOY, S),               % -15..+15
        % Fajr around 04:20 baseline minus S (earlier in summer)
        baseFajr = time(4,20),
        addMinutesClampDay(baseFajr, -S*3, Fajr0),   % amplify drift x3
        % Sunrise ~ Fajr + 95 +/- S
        addMinutesClampDay(Fajr0, 95 + S, Sunrise0),
        Sunrise = Sunrise0,
        % Dhuhr baseline ~ 12:00 slight shift by S/5
        addMinutesClampDay(time(12,0), S div 5, Dhuhr0),
        Dhuhr = Dhuhr0,
        % Asr ~ Dhuhr + 4:00 + ((S)/6)
        addMinutesClampDay(Dhuhr0, 240 + (S div 6), Asr0),
        Asr = Asr0,
        % Maghrib: approx 6h after Dhuhr - small seasonal adjustment -S/2
        addMinutesClampDay(Dhuhr0, 360 - (S div 2), Maghrib0),
        Maghrib = Maghrib0,
        % Isha: ~ 90 minutes after Maghrib + tiny S/4
        addMinutesClampDay(Maghrib0, 90 + (S div 4), Isha0),
        Isha = Isha0.

    genGizaDay(Date, Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) :-
        genCairoDay(Date, F0,S0,D0,A0,M0,I0),
        addMinutesClampDay(F0, 1, Fajr),
        addMinutesClampDay(S0, 1, Sunrise),
        addMinutesClampDay(D0, 1, Dhuhr),
        addMinutesClampDay(A0, 1, Asr),
        addMinutesClampDay(M0, 1, Maghrib),
        addMinutesClampDay(I0, 1, Isha).

% --------------------------------------------
% Initialization: populate dynamic facts for Cairo & Giza all 2023 days
% --------------------------------------------
predicates
    initData : () determ.
    assertYearForGov : (gov) determ.
clauses
    initData() :-
        % Clear any existing
        retractAllDyn(),
        % Populate Cairo & Giza base
        assertYearForGov(cairo),
        assertYearForGov(giza).

    assertYearForGov(Gov) :-
        ( for I = 1 to 12 do
            monthLength2023(I, ML),
            ( for D = 1 to ML do
                Date = date(2023, I, D),
                ( if Gov = cairo then
                    genCairoDay(Date,F,S,Dh,A,M,Ish)
                  else
                    genGizaDay(Date,F,S,Dh,A,M,Ish)
                  end if ),
                assert(dyn_prayer(Gov, Date, F,S,Dh,A,M,Ish))
            end for )
          end for ).

predicates
    retractAllDyn : () determ.
clauses
    retractAllDyn() :-
        ( dyn_prayer(_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_) ->
            retract(dyn_prayer(_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_)),
            retractAllDyn()
          ; true ).

% --------------------------------------------
% Access rules
% --------------------------------------------
predicates
    % Base data accessor (Cairo & Giza from dyn; others derived from Cairo by offset)
    basePrayerTimes : (gov, date, time, time, time, time, time, time) determ.
clauses
    basePrayerTimes(Gov, Date, F,S,Dh,A,M,Ish) :-
        ( Gov = cairo ; Gov = giza ),
        dyn_prayer(Gov, Date, F,S,Dh,A,M,Ish), !.
    basePrayerTimes(Gov, Date, F,S,Dh,A,M,Ish) :-
        % derive from Cairo + govOffset
        Gov \= cairo, Gov \= giza,
        is2023Date(Date),
        dyn_prayer(cairo, Date, Fc,Sc,Dhc,Ac,Mc,Ic),
        govOffset(Gov, Delta),
        addMinutesClampDay(Fc,  Delta, F),
        addMinutesClampDay(Sc,  Delta, S),
        addMinutesClampDay(Dhc, Delta, Dh),
        addMinutesClampDay(Ac,  Delta, A),
        addMinutesClampDay(Mc,  Delta, M),
        addMinutesClampDay(Ic,  Delta, Ish).

% --------------------------------------------
% Queries required by the task
% --------------------------------------------

% 1) Minimum Isha across all governorates & all 2023 dates.
% Returns (Governorate, Date, Isha)
predicates
    minIshaAll : (gov, date, time) determ.
clauses
    minIshaAll(Gmin, Dmin, Tmin) :-
        % Initialize with Cairo Jan 1
        Start = date(2023,1,1),
        governorate(G0),
        basePrayerTimes(G0, Start, _,_,_,_,_, I0),
        iterateMinIsha(G0, Start, I0, Gmin, Dmin, Tmin).

predicates
    iterateMinIsha : (gov, date, time, gov, date, time) determ.
clauses
    iterateMinIsha(Gcur, Dcur, Tcur, Gmin, Dmin, Tmin) :-
        % Walk all govs and all dates
        ( nextGovDate(G, D) ->
            basePrayerTimes(G, D, _,_,_,_,_, I),
            ( timeToMinutes(I, NI), timeToMinutes(Tcur, NC), NI < NC ->
                iterateMinIsha(G, D, I, Gmin, Dmin, Tmin)
              ;
                iterateMinIsha(Gcur, Dcur, Tcur, Gmin, Dmin, Tmin)
            )
          ;
            Gmin = Gcur, Dmin = Dcur, Tmin = Tcur
        ).

% Enumerator over all (gov, date) pairs deterministically
predicates
    nextGovDate : (gov, date) nondet.
    eachDate2023 : (date) nondet.
clauses
    nextGovDate(G, D) :-
        governorate(G),
        eachDate2023(D).

    eachDate2023(date(2023,M,D)) :-
        monthLength2023(M, ML),
        ( for MM = 1 to 12 do
            ( for DD = 1 to monthLength2023Inline(MM) do
                M = MM,
                D = DD
            end for )
          end for ).

predicates
    monthLength2023Inline : (integer) integer.
clauses
    monthLength2023Inline(1) = 31.
    monthLength2023Inline(2) = 28.
    monthLength2023Inline(3) = 31.
    monthLength2023Inline(4) = 30.
    monthLength2023Inline(5) = 31.
    monthLength2023Inline(6) = 30.
    monthLength2023Inline(7) = 31.
    monthLength2023Inline(8) = 31.
    monthLength2023Inline(9) = 30.
    monthLength2023Inline(10) = 31.
    monthLength2023Inline(11) = 30.
    monthLength2023Inline(12) = 31.

class predicates
    sumDaysToMonthAcc : (integer Year, integer CurM, integer LastM, integer Acc, integer S) determ.
clauses
    sumDaysToMonthAcc(_, CurM, LastM, Acc, Acc) :- CurM > LastM, !.
    sumDaysToMonthAcc(Year, CurM, LastM, Acc, S):-
        monthLength(Year, CurM, D),
        Acc1 = Acc + D,
        CurM1 = CurM + 1,
        sumDaysToMonthAcc(Year, CurM1, LastM, Acc1, S).

    % Placeholder time generator:
    % We create plausible monotonic day-length shifts across the year and small per-governorate offsets.
    % The output respects ordering: Fajr < Sunrise < Dhuhr < Asr < Maghrib < Isha.
    %
    % Base model:
    %   Use DOY to create seasonal variation. For 2024 (leap), DOY in [1..366].
    %   We set:
    %     Fajr around 5:00 +/- 45m seasonal +/- govOffset
    %     Sunrise about Fajr + 1h30
    %     Dhuhr around 12:00 +/- 30m seasonal +/- small offset
    %     Asr about Dhuhr + 4h
    %     Maghrib about Sunrise + 11h50 (approx day length) +/- small change
    %     Isha about Maghrib + 1h30
    %
    % All times clamped to 0..23:59 and adjusted to maintain strict order by adding minimal safe gaps if needed.
    computeTimes(Gov, DOY, Fh,Fm, Sh,Sm, Dh,Dm, Ah,Am, Mh,Mm, Ih,Im):-
        % Seasonal factor: cos-like cycle using DOY; since we lack trig, approximate with a sawtooth over the year:
        % Let seasonShift range in [-1.0, +1.0] piecewise linear:
        seasonPos = DOY,  % 1..366
        Half = 183,       % half-year
        ( seasonPos =< Half ->
            % rising from -1 to +1
            Num = (seasonPos - 1) * 2, Den = Half - 1,
            Season1000 = (Num * 1000) / Den - 1000
          ;
            % falling from +1 to -1
            Num2 = (seasonPos - Half - 1) * 2, Den2 = 366 - Half - 1,  % 182 - 1 = 181
            Season1000 = 1000 - (Num2 * 1000) / Den2
        ),
        % seasonShift ~ [-1000..+1000] where 1000 == 1.0
        % Governorate offset index (stable, derived from name hash-ish)
        govIndex = govKey(Gov),
        govMin = govIndex mod 7,         % 0..6
        govOffMin = govMin * 2,          % 0..12 minutes
        govOffHour = (govIndex mod 3),   % 0..2 hours for testing spread
        % Base anchors (in minutes since midnight)
        BaseFajr = 5*60,                 % 05:00
        BaseSunriseGap = 90,             % +1:30
        BaseDhuhr = 12*60,               % 12:00
        BaseAsrGap = 240,                % +4:00
        BaseDayLen = 710,                % Sunrise->Maghrib approx 11:50 (710 min)
        BaseIshaGap = 90,                % +1:30 after Maghrib
        % Seasonal adjustments in minutes
        % Fajr earlier in summer (Season=+1 -> earlier): use -45 .. +45 inverse
        FajrAdj = - (Season1000 * 45) / 1000,     % -45..+45 (int)
        DhuhrAdj = (Season1000 * 15) / 1000,      % -15..+15
        DayLenAdj = (Season1000 * 30) / 1000,     % -30..+30 (shorter winter)
        % Compose times
        FajrMin0 = BaseFajr + FajrAdj + govOffMin + govOffHour*60,
        SunriseMin0 = FajrMin0 + BaseSunriseGap + 2,  % +2 min safety
        DhuhrMin0 = BaseDhuhr + DhuhrAdj + (govOffMin mod 5),
        AsrMin0 = DhuhrMin0 + BaseAsrGap + 2,
        MaghribMin0 = SunriseMin0 + BaseDayLen + DayLenAdj + 2,
        IshaMin0 = MaghribMin0 + BaseIshaGap + 2,
        % Ensure ordering with minimal gaps:
        ensureAsc(FajrMin0, SunriseMin0, DhuhrMin0, AsrMin0, MaghribMin0, IshaMin0,
                  Fmin,Smin,Dmin,Amin,Mmin,Imin),
        % Clamp to 0..(24h-1)
        clampDay(Fmin, FminC), clampDay(Smin, SminC), clampDay(Dmin, DminC),
        clampDay(Amin, AminC), clampDay(Mmin, MminC), clampDay(Imin, IminC),
        % Convert to HH:MM
        minsToHM(FminC, Fh,Fm),
        minsToHM(SminC, Sh,Sm),
        minsToHM(DminC, Dh,Dm),
        minsToHM(AminC, Ah,Am),
        minsToHM(MminC, Mh,Mm),
        minsToHM(IminC, Ih,Im).

class predicates
    govKey : (string Gov) -> integer K.
    minsToHM : (integer TotalMin, integer H, integer M).
    ensureAsc : (integer F,integer S,integer D,integer A,integer M,integer I,
                 integer Fo,integer So,integer Do,integer Ao,integer Mo,integer Io).
    clampDay : (integer MinIn, integer MinOut).
clauses
    govKey(Gov) = K:-
        str_len(Gov, L),
        sumChars(Gov, 1, L, 0, Sum),
        K = Sum.

class predicates
    sumChars : (string S, integer I, integer N, integer Acc, integer Out) determ.
clauses
    sumChars(S, I, N, Acc, Acc) :- I > N, !.
    sumChars(S, I, N, Acc, Out):-
        getCharCode(S, I, C),
        Acc1 = Acc + C,
        I1 = I + 1,
        sumChars(S, I1, N, Acc1, Out).

class predicates
    getCharCode : (string S, integer I, integer Code) determ.
clauses
    getCharCode(S, I, Code):-
        sub_string(S, I, 1, Ch),
        char_code(Ch, Code).

class predicates
    sub_string : (string S, integer Pos, integer Len, string Out) determ.
    char_code : (string Ch, integer Code) determ.
clauses
    % Visual Prolog 5.2 lacks built-ins for these; we implement minimal versions.
    sub_string(S, Pos, Len, Out):-
        string::subString(S, Pos, Len, Out).

    char_code(Ch, Code):-
        string::getCharacterCode(Ch, Code).

clauses
    minsToHM(TotalMin, H, M):-
        H = (TotalMin div 60) mod 24,
        M = TotalMin mod 60.

    ensureAsc(F,S,D,A,M,I, Fo,So,Do,Ao,Mo,Io):-
        gap = 1,
        S1 = max(S, F + 1 + gap),
        D1 = max(D, S1 + 1 + gap),
        A1 = max(A, D1 + 1 + gap),
        M1 = max(M, A1 + 1 + gap),
        I1 = max(I, M1 + 1 + gap),
        Fo = F, So = S1, Do = D1, Ao = A1, Mo = M1, Io = I1.

    clampDay(MinIn, MinOut):-
        Day = 24*60,
        MinOut = ((MinIn mod Day) + Day) mod Day.

    % Comparison utils
    lessTime(H1,M1,H2,M2):- T1 = H1*60 + M1, T2 = H2*60 + M2, T1 < T2.
    greaterTime(H1,M1,H2,M2):- T1 = H1*60 + M1, T2 = H2*60 + M2, T1 > T2.

    % Formatting helpers
    pad2(N,S):-
        ( N < 10 -> S = "0", number::toString(N, Ns), S = S + Ns
        ; number::toString(N, S)
        ).

    writeTime(H, M):-
        pad2(H, SH), pad2(M, SM),
        write(SH), write(":"), write(SM).

    minIsha(Gov,Y,M,D,H,Min):-
        prayerTime(Gov, date(Y,M,D), _, _, _, _, _, isha(H,Min)).

# neural_3d_generator.py
# A simple conditional neural network in PyTorch that learns to generate 3D arrays
# from token sequences. It provides train(), saveWeights(), loadWeights(), generate().

import os
import math
import random
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple, Union, Counter

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.nn.utils.rnn import pack_padded_sequence, pad_packed_sequence
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset

# ---------------------------
# Utilities and global state
# ---------------------------

def _set_seed(seed: int = 42):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


class _TokenVocab:
    def __init__(self):
        self.pad_token = "<PAD>"
        self.unk_token = "<UNK>"
        self.token2idx: Dict[str, int] = {self.pad_token: 0, self.unk_token: 1}
        self.idx2token: List[str] = [self.pad_token, self.unk_token]

    @property
    def pad_idx(self) -> int:
        return self.token2idx[self.pad_token]

    @property
    def unk_idx(self) -> int:
        return self.token2idx[self.unk_token]

    def build(self, data_pairs: Iterable[Tuple[Sequence[Any], np.ndarray]]):
        for tokens, _ in data_pairs:
            for t in tokens:
                key = str(t)
                if key not in self.token2idx:
                    self.token2idx[key] = len(self.idx2token)
                    self.idx2token.append(key)

    def encode(self, tokens: Sequence[Any]) -> List[int]:
        return [self.token2idx.get(str(t), self.unk_idx) for t in tokens]

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.idx2token)


def _compute_default_shape(shapes: List[Tuple[int, ...]]) -> Tuple[int, ...]:
    # Choose the most common shape; if tie, choose the first encountered
    from collections import Counter as PyCounter
    counter: PyCounter[Tuple[int, ...]] = PyCounter(shapes)
    default_shape, _ = counter.most_common(1)[0]
    return default_shape


@dataclass
class _ModelState:
    model: nn.Module
    vocab: _TokenVocab
    device: torch.device
    out_channels: int
    norm_min: np.ndarray  # shape [C]
    norm_max: np.ndarray  # shape [C]
    default_shape: Tuple[int, int, int]  # (D, H, W)
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]


_STATE: Optional[_ModelState] = None


# ---------------------------
# Dataset and Collation
# ---------------------------

def _to_ch_first(vol: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    # Accept (D, H, W) -> (1, D, H, W)
    # Accept (C, D, H, W) -> unchanged
    if vol.ndim == 3:
        return vol[None, ...]
    elif vol.ndim == 4:
        return vol
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected 3D or 4D array. Got shape {vol.shape} with ndim={vol.ndim}.")


class _VolumeDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, pairs: List[Tuple[Sequence[Any], np.ndarray]], vocab: _TokenVocab):
        if len(pairs) == 0:
            raise ValueError("Empty dataset: at least one (tokens, 3D array) pair is required.")
        self.vocab = vocab
        self.samples_tokens: List[List[int]] = []
        arrays_ch_first: List[np.ndarray] = []

        # Convert arrays to C,D,H,W shape
        for tokens, arr in pairs:
            if not isinstance(tokens, (list, tuple)):
                # Allow any Sequence[Any]; ensure iterability
                try:
                    _ = list(tokens)  # may raise TypeError if not iterable
                except Exception as e:
                    raise TypeError("tokens must be a sequence convertible to list") from e
            arr = np.asarray(arr)
            if arr.dtype != np.float32:
                arr = arr.astype(np.float32)
            arr_cf = _to_ch_first(arr)
            arrays_ch_first.append(arr_cf)
            self.samples_tokens.append(vocab.encode(tokens))

        # Validate consistent channels
        ch_counts = {arr.shape[0] for arr in arrays_ch_first}
        if len(ch_counts) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"Inconsistent number of channels across volumes: {ch_counts}")
        self.C = arrays_ch_first[0].shape[0]

        # Compute per-channel normalization stats across all volumes
        mins = np.full((self.C,), np.inf, dtype=np.float32)
        maxs = np.full((self.C,), -np.inf, dtype=np.float32)
        for arr in arrays_ch_first:
            arr_min = arr.reshape(self.C, -1).min(axis=1)
            arr_max = arr.reshape(self.C, -1).max(axis=1)
            mins = np.minimum(mins, arr_min)
            maxs = np.maximum(maxs, arr_max)
        ranges = np.maximum(maxs - mins, 1e-6)
        self.norm_min = mins
        self.norm_max = maxs
        self.norm_range = ranges

        # Normalize arrays to [0,1]
        self.samples_arrays: List[np.ndarray] = []
        self.shapes: List[Tuple[int, int, int]] = []
        for arr in arrays_ch_first:
            normed = (arr - self.norm_min[:, None, None, None]) / self.norm_range[:, None, None, None]
            normed = np.clip(normed, 0.0, 1.0)
            self.samples_arrays.append(normed.astype(np.float32))
            self.shapes.append(tuple(arr.shape[1:4]))  # D,H,W

        self.default_shape: Tuple[int, int, int] = _compute_default_shape(self.shapes)

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self.samples_arrays)

    def __getitem__(self, idx: int) -> Tuple[List[int], torch.Tensor, Tuple[int, int, int]]:
        tokens_ids = self.samples_tokens[idx]
        vol = torch.from_numpy(self.samples_arrays[idx])  # (C,D,H,W) float32
        shp = self.shapes[idx]
        return tokens_ids, vol, shp


def _collate_batch(batch: List[Tuple[List[int], torch.Tensor, Tuple[int, int, int]]]):
    # Pad token sequences, stack volumes
    token_lists, vols, shapes = zip(*batch)
    lengths = torch.tensor([len(t) for t in token_lists], dtype=torch.long)
    max_len = int(lengths.max().item()) if lengths.numel() > 0 else 0
    if max_len == 0:
        tokens_padded = torch.zeros((len(batch), 1), dtype=torch.long)
        lengths = torch.ones((len(batch),), dtype=torch.long)
    else:
        tokens_padded = torch.full((len(batch), max_len), 0, dtype=torch.long)  # pad idx 0
        for i, t in enumerate(token_lists):
            if len(t) > 0:
                tokens_padded[i, : len(t)] = torch.tensor(t, dtype=torch.long)
            else:
                lengths[i] = 1  # treat empty as length 1 pad-only
    vols_t = torch.stack(vols, dim=0)  # (B,C,D,H,W)
    return tokens_padded, lengths, vols_t, shapes


# ---------------------------
# Model
# ---------------------------

class TokenEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size: int, emb_dim: int = 128, rnn_hidden: int = 256, num_layers: int = 1, pad_idx: int = 0):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, emb_dim, padding_idx=pad_idx)
        self.gru = nn.GRU(emb_dim, rnn_hidden, num_layers=num_layers, batch_first=True, bidirectional=False)
        self.rnn_hidden = rnn_hidden

    def forward(self, tokens: torch.Tensor, lengths: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        # tokens: (B, T), lengths: (B,)
        emb = self.embedding(tokens)  # (B,T,E)
        # pack
        lengths_cpu = lengths.detach().cpu()
        # Replace zeros with ones to avoid pack error
        lengths_fixed = torch.clamp(lengths_cpu, min=1)
        packed = pack_padded_sequence(emb, lengths_fixed, batch_first=True, enforce_sorted=False)
        _, h_n = self.gru(packed)  # h_n: (num_layers, B, H)
        h = h_n[-1]  # (B,H)
        return h


class ResBlock3D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv3d(channels, channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm3d(channels)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv3d(channels, channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm3d(channels)
        self.act = nn.SiLU()

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        identity = x
        out = self.act(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        out = self.act(out + identity)
        return out


class UpBlock3D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch: int, out_ch: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.upsample = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="trilinear", align_corners=False)
        self.conv = nn.Conv3d(in_ch, out_ch, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm3d(out_ch)
        self.act = nn.SiLU()
        self.res = ResBlock3D(out_ch)

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        x = self.upsample(x)
        x = self.act(self.bn(self.conv(x)))
        x = self.res(x)
        return x


class ConditionalGenerator3D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size: int, out_channels: int, base_channels: int = 64, cond_dim: int = 256, latent_dim: int = 128, pad_idx: int = 0):
        super().__init__()
        # Token encoder
        self.encoder = TokenEncoder(vocab_size, emb_dim=128, rnn_hidden=cond_dim, num_layers=1, pad_idx=pad_idx)
        self.cond_dim = cond_dim
        self.latent_dim = latent_dim
        # Map condition -> initial 3D feature cube (base spatial = 4x4x4)
        self.init_DHW = (4, 4, 4)
        self.init_channels = base_channels * 4
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(cond_dim + latent_dim, self.init_channels * math.prod(self.init_DHW)),
            nn.SiLU(),
        )
        # Upsampling path to reach variable shapes via interpolation at the end
        self.up1 = UpBlock3D(self.init_channels, base_channels * 2)  # 8
        self.up2 = UpBlock3D(base_channels * 2, base_channels)      # 16
        self.up3 = UpBlock3D(base_channels, base_channels // 2)     # 32 (optional overshoot)
        self.to_feat = nn.Conv3d(base_channels // 2, base_channels // 2, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.act = nn.SiLU()
        self.head = nn.Conv3d(base_channels // 2, out_channels, kernel_size=1)
        # final activation will be sigmoid to get [0,1]

    def forward(self, tokens: torch.Tensor, lengths: torch.Tensor, target_shape: Tuple[int, int, int], noise: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Encode tokens
        cond = self.encoder(tokens, lengths)  # (B,cond_dim)
        B = cond.size(0)
        if noise is None:
            noise = torch.randn(B, self.latent_dim, device=cond.device)
        h = torch.cat([cond, noise], dim=1)  # (B, cond+latent)
        x = self.fc(h)  # (B, init_channels*4*4*4)
        x = x.view(B, self.init_channels, *self.init_DHW)  # (B,C,4,4,4)
        x = self.up1(x)  # 8
        x = self.up2(x)  # 16
        x = self.up3(x)  # 32
        x = self.act(self.to_feat(x))
        # Resize to target_shape using trilinear interpolate
        x = F.interpolate(x, size=target_shape, mode="trilinear", align_corners=False)
        x = self.head(x)
        x = torch.sigmoid(x)  # [0,1]
        return x


# ---------------------------
# Training / API functions
# ---------------------------

def train(pairs: List[Tuple[Sequence[Any], np.ndarray]], epochs: int = 10, lr: float = 1e-3, batch_size: int = 4, seed: int = 42) -> None:
    """
    Train the conditional 3D generator.
    pairs: list of (tokens, 3D array) where array is (D,H,W) or (C,D,H,W) float32. C consistent across pairs.
    Normalizes per-channel to [0,1] internally.
    """
    global _STATE
    if not isinstance(pairs, list) or len(pairs) == 0:
        raise ValueError("train() requires a non-empty list of (tokens, 3D array) pairs.")

    _set_seed(seed)

    # Build vocab
    vocab = _TokenVocab()
    vocab.build(pairs)

    # Dataset
    dataset = _VolumeDataset(pairs, vocab)
    default_shape = dataset.default_shape
    out_channels = dataset.C

    # Dataloader
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, collate_fn=_collate_batch, num_workers=0)

    # Device
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    # Model
    hparams = dict(
        base_channels=64,
        cond_dim=256,
        latent_dim=128,
        emb_dim=128,
    )
    model = ConditionalGenerator3D(
        vocab_size=vocab.size(),
        out_channels=out_channels,
        base_channels=hparams["base_channels"],
        cond_dim=hparams["cond_dim"],
        latent_dim=hparams["latent_dim"],
        pad_idx=vocab.pad_idx,
    ).to(device)

    # Optimizer and loss
    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr)
    criterion = nn.L1Loss()

    model.train()
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        epoch_loss = 0.0
        n_batches = 0
        for tokens_padded, lengths, vols_t, shapes in loader:
            tokens_padded = tokens_padded.to(device)
            lengths = lengths.to(device)
            vols_t = vols_t.to(device)  # (B,C,D,H,W) already normalized [0,1]
            # Determine per-sample shapes and run individually or via max-size batching
            # For simplicity, generate to each sample's own shape by iterating mini-batch if shapes differ
            if len(set(shapes)) == 1:
                target_shape = shapes[0]
                preds = model(tokens_padded, lengths, target_shape=target_shape)
                loss = criterion(preds, vols_t)
                opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                loss.backward()
                opt.step()
                epoch_loss += float(loss.detach().cpu().item())
                n_batches += 1
            else:
                # Process samples one by one to match shapes
                bsz = vols_t.size(0)
                losses = []
                for i in range(bsz):
                    tok_i = tokens_padded[i:i+1]
                    len_i = lengths[i:i+1]
                    vol_i = vols_t[i:i+1]
                    shp_i = shapes[i]
                    pred_i = model(tok_i, len_i, target_shape=shp_i)
                    loss_i = criterion(pred_i, vol_i)
                    losses.append(loss_i)
                loss = torch.stack(losses).mean()
                opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                loss.backward()
                opt.step()
                epoch_loss += float(loss.detach().cpu().item())
                n_batches += 1

        avg_loss = epoch_loss / max(n_batches, 1)
        # Optional: print progress
        print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{epochs} - loss: {avg_loss:.4f}")

    # Save state
    _STATE = _ModelState(
        model=model.eval(),
        vocab=vocab,
        device=device,
        out_channels=out_channels,
        norm_min=dataset.norm_min.copy(),
        norm_max=dataset.norm_max.copy(),
        default_shape=default_shape,
        hparams=hparams,
    )


def saveWeights(path: str) -> None:
    """
    Save model weights and metadata to a file.
    """
    global _STATE
    if _STATE is None:
        raise RuntimeError("No trained model state to save. Call train() or loadWeights() first.")
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
    state = {
        "model_state_dict": _STATE.model.state_dict(),
        "vocab_token2idx": _STATE.vocab.token2idx,
        "vocab_idx2token": _STATE.vocab.idx2token,
        "out_channels": _STATE.out_channels,
        "norm_min": _STATE.norm_min,
        "norm_max": _STATE.norm_max,
        "default_shape": _STATE.default_shape,
        "hparams": _STATE.hparams,
        "torch_version": torch.__version__,
    }
    torch.save(state, path)
    print(f"Saved weights to {path}")


def loadWeights(path: str, map_location: Optional[Union[str, torch.device]] = None) -> None:
    """
    Load model weights and metadata from a file saved by saveWeights().
    """
    global _STATE
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Weights file not found: {path}")
    checkpoint = torch.load(path, map_location=map_location if map_location is not None else "cpu")

    # Rebuild vocab
    vocab = _TokenVocab()
    # Use saved mappings to preserve indices
    vocab.token2idx = dict(checkpoint["vocab_token2idx"])
    vocab.idx2token = list(checkpoint["vocab_idx2token"])

    out_channels = int(checkpoint["out_channels"])
    hparams = checkpoint.get("hparams", dict(base_channels=64, cond_dim=256, latent_dim=128, emb_dim=128))

    device = torch.device(map_location) if map_location is not None else torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    model = ConditionalGenerator3D(
        vocab_size=len(vocab.idx2token),
        out_channels=out_channels,
        base_channels=hparams.get("base_channels", 64),
        cond_dim=hparams.get("cond_dim", 256),
        latent_dim=hparams.get("latent_dim", 128),
        pad_idx=vocab.pad_idx,
    )
    model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model_state_dict"], strict=True)
    model.to(device)
    model.eval()

    _STATE = _ModelState(
        model=model,
        vocab=vocab,
        device=device,
        out_channels=out_channels,
        norm_min=np.asarray(checkpoint["norm_min"]).astype(np.float32),
        norm_max=np.asarray(checkpoint["norm_max"]).astype(np.float32),
        default_shape=tuple(checkpoint["default_shape"]),
        hparams=hparams,
    )
    print(f"Loaded weights from {path} (device={device})")


def generate(tokens: Sequence[Any], shape: Optional[Tuple[int, int, int]] = None, seed: Optional[int] = None) -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Generate a 3D array conditioned on tokens. Returns float32 array in the original channel format:
    - If training used C=1, returns (D,H,W)
    - If training used C>1, returns (C,D,H,W)
    shape: (D,H,W); if None, uses the most common training shape.
    """
    global _STATE
    if _STATE is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Model is not initialized. Call train() or loadWeights() first.")
    if seed is not None:
        _set_seed(seed)

    model: ConditionalGenerator3D = _STATE.model  # type: ignore
    vocab = _STATE.vocab
    device = _STATE.device
    C = _STATE.out_channels

    if shape is None:
        D, H, W = _STATE.default_shape
    else:
        if not (isinstance(shape, (list, tuple)) and len(shape) == 3):
            raise ValueError("shape must be a tuple/list of (D,H,W) if provided.")
        D, H, W = tuple(int(s) for s in shape)

    # Prepare token tensor
    tok_ids = vocab.encode(tokens)
    if len(tok_ids) == 0:
        # Provide at least one pad token to allow encoder forward
        tok_ids = [vocab.pad_idx]
    tokens_t = torch.tensor([tok_ids], dtype=torch.long, device=device)
    lengths_t = torch.tensor([len(tok_ids)], dtype=torch.long, device=device)

    with torch.no_grad():
        pred = model(tokens_t, lengths_t, target_shape=(D, H, W))  # (1,C,D,H,W) in [0,1]
    vol_norm = pred.squeeze(0).detach().cpu().numpy()  # (C,D,H,W)

    # Denormalize back to original scale
    min_c = _STATE.norm_min[:, None, None, None]
    max_c = _STATE.norm_max[:, None, None, None]
    range_c = np.maximum(max_c - min_c, 1e-6)
    vol = vol_norm * range_c + min_c  # (C,D,H,W)
    vol = vol.astype(np.float32)

    if C == 1:
        return vol[0]
    else:
        return vol
