import c4d
import math
from c4d import utils

# User Data IDs (adjust if your IDs differ)
UD_SUBDIV = c4d.ID_USERDATA,1   # Integer
UD_MAXLEN = c4d.ID_USERDATA,2   # Float
UD_FIELD  = c4d.ID_USERDATA,3   # Link
UD_WSPACE = c4d.ID_USERDATA,4   # Bool

# Helper: evaluate a field strength [0..1] at a position
def eval_field(doc, fieldObj, pos, wspace):
    if fieldObj is None:
        return 0.0
    falloff = fieldObj.GetFieldObject()
    if falloff is None:
        return 0.0
    # Build a FieldList evaluation context
    flist = c4d.modules.mograph.FieldList()
    flist.Init(doc, None, c4d.modules.mograph.fields.FIELDSAMPLE_FLAG_VALUE)
    flist.InsertObject(fieldObj, 1.0, c4d.modules.mograph.fields.FIELDINPUT_OBJECT)
    md = c4d.modules.mograph.FieldInput()
    md.Init(None, None)
    # position space
    p = pos if not wspace else pos
    # Sample one point
    arrPos = c4d.modules.mograph.FieldInputPoints()
    arrPos.InitFromPositions([p])
    md.SetPoints(arrPos)
    out = flist.Sample(None, md, None, c4d.modules.mograph.fields.FIELDSAMPLE_FLAG_VALUE)
    if out is None or len(out) == 0:
        return 0.0
    return max(0.0, min(1.0, out[0]))

# Midpoint cache to avoid duplicate vertices when splitting
class EdgeKey(tuple):
    def __new__(cls, a, b):
        return super().__new__(cls, (min(a,b), max(a,b)))

def midpoint(p1, p2):
    return (p1 + p2) * 0.5

# Subdivide a triangle into 4 smaller triangles
def subdivide_tri(idx, tri, pts, mp_cache):
    a,b,c = tri
    pa,pb,pc = pts[a], pts[b], pts[c]
    abk, bck, cak = EdgeKey(a,b), EdgeKey(b,c), EdgeKey(c,a)
    if abk not in mp_cache:
        mp_cache[abk] = len(pts); pts.append(midpoint(pa,pb))
    if bck not in mp_cache:
        mp_cache[bck] = len(pts); pts.append(midpoint(pb,pc))
    if cak not in mp_cache:
        mp_cache[cak] = len(pts); pts.append(midpoint(pc,pa))
    ab = mp_cache[abk]
    bc = mp_cache[bck]
    ca = mp_cache[cak]
    # 4 triangles
    return [(a, ab, ca), (ab, b, bc), (ca, bc, c), (ab, bc, ca)]

# Subdivide a quad by splitting into 4 quads via midpoints (then triangulate later)
def subdivide_quad(quad, pts, mp_cache):
    a,b,c,d = quad
    pa,pb,pc,pd = pts[a], pts[b], pts[c], pts[d]
    abk, bck, cdk, dak = EdgeKey(a,b), EdgeKey(b,c), EdgeKey(c,d), EdgeKey(d,a)
    if abk not in mp_cache:
        mp_cache[abk] = len(pts); pts.append(midpoint(pa,pb))
    if bck not in mp_cache:
        mp_cache[bck] = len(pts); pts.append(midpoint(pb,pc))
    if cdk not in mp_cache:
        mp_cache[cdk] = len(pts); pts.append(midpoint(pc,pd))
    if dak not in mp_cache:
        mp_cache[dak] = len(pts); pts.append(midpoint(pd,pa))
    ab = mp_cache[abk]
    bc = mp_cache[bck]
    cd = mp_cache[cdk]
    da = mp_cache[dak]
    # center point
    center = len(pts); pts.append((pts[ab]+pts[bc]+pts[cd]+pts[da]) * 0.25)
    ce = center
    # 4 quads as triangles (triangulate quads into two tris later anyway)
    # Return as triangles right away for simplicity
    return [
        (a, ab, ce), (ab, b, ce),
        (b, bc, ce), (bc, c, ce),
        (c, cd, ce), (cd, d, ce),
        (d, da, ce), (da, a, ce)
    ]

# Compute polygon center in either object or world space
def poly_center(poly, pts, op, use_world):
    idxs = []
    if poly.c == poly.d: # triangle
        idxs = [poly.a, poly.b, poly.c]
    else:
        idxs = [poly.a, poly.b, poly.c, poly.d]
    ps = [pts[i] for i in idxs]
    c = c4d.Vector()
    for p in ps:
        c += p
    c /= float(len(ps))
    if use_world:
        c = op.GetMg() * c
    return c

def main():
    op = doc.GetActiveObject() if op is None else op
    if op is None or op.GetType() != c4d.Opolygon:
        return True

    depth = op[c4d.ID_USERDATA,1] if op.GetUserDataContainer() else 0
    maxlen = op[c4d.ID_USERDATA,2] if op.GetUserDataContainer() else 1e9
    fieldObj = op[c4d.ID_USERDATA,3] if op.GetUserDataContainer() else None
    use_world = bool(op[c4d.ID_USERDATA,4]) if op.GetUserDataContainer() else True

    # Base geometry
    src_pts = list(op.GetAllPoints())
    polys = op.GetAllPolygons()

    # Safety: bail early if nothing to do
    if depth <= 0 or fieldObj is None or len(polys) == 0:
        return True

    new_pts = list(src_pts)
    new_tris = []

    # We convert all polys to triangles for consistent subdivision
    tri_list = []
    for poly in polys:
        if poly.c == poly.d: # triangle
            tri_list.append((poly.a, poly.b, poly.c))
        else: # quad -> 2 triangles
            tri_list.append((poly.a, poly.b, poly.c))
            tri_list.append((poly.a, poly.c, poly.d))

    mp_cache = {}

    # Determine per-triangle target depth using field value at center
    # Effective depth = round(fieldStrength * depth)
    for tri in tri_list:
        # Temporary fake polygon struct to reuse poly_center
        p = c4d.CPolygon(tri[0], tri[1], tri[2])
        p.d = p.c
        ctr = poly_center(p, new_pts, op, use_world)
        strength = eval_field(doc, fieldObj, ctr, use_world)
        tdepth = int(round(max(0, min(depth, depth * strength))))

        # Early-out on overly long edges unless subdividing
        if tdepth == 0:
            # Optional guard: if edges longer than maxlen, split once
            a,b,c = tri
            if (new_pts[a]-new_pts[b]).GetLength() > maxlen or \
               (new_pts[b]-new_pts[c]).GetLength() > maxlen or \
               (new_pts[c]-new_pts[a]).GetLength() > maxlen:
                tdepth = 1

        # Recurse subdivision tdepth times
        stack = [tri]
        for _ in range(tdepth):
            next_stack = []
            for t in stack:
                # Use quad subdiv for near-planar quads only; we’re on tris so:
                next_stack.extend(subdivide_tri(0, t, new_pts, mp_cache))
            stack = next_stack
        new_tris.extend(stack)

    # Build a new polygon object from new_pts and triangulated faces
    res = c4d.PolygonObject(len(new_pts), len(new_tris))
    res.SetAllPoints(new_pts)

    res_polys = []
    for a,b,c in new_tris:
        res_polys.append(c4d.CPolygon(a,b,c))
    res.SetAllPolygons(res_polys)
    res.Message(c4d.MSG_UPDATE)

    # Replace current state (as deformer output)
    op.SetDeformCache(res)
    return True

Key limitations/considerations

- Topology reset: This approach outputs triangulated meshes; UVs, vertex maps, selections, and normals are not preserved. Use for previews or localized effects, not final production topology.

- No visible change: Increase SubdivisionDepth, reduce MaxEdgeLength, move the field over the mesh.
- Slow or hangs: Lower depth, reduce polygon count, or switch to Scene Nodes.

from c4d import utils

# ---------------------- User Parameters ----------------------
MAX_DEPTH = 1           # 0=no recursion, 1=one pass, 2=two passes (use with care)
THRESHOLD = 0.5         # Average field weight above this subdivides a triangle
FALLOFF_MULT = 1.0      # Scales sampled field strength
SEED = 12345            # For any stochastic extensions (unused here)
# -------------------------------------------------------------

# Helper: Get FieldList from this deformer (supports Fields tab)
def get_field_list(op):
    # In C4D 2024, Python Deformer supports fields via DescID(c4d.FIELDS)
    # We access via op.GetFieldList(False) which returns a c4d.FieldList
    try:
        return op.GetFieldList(False)
    except Exception:
        return None

# Sample field weight at a world-space position
def sample_field_weight(doc, op, fld, wpos):
    if fld is None:
        return 0.0
    # FieldList.Sample takes a FieldInput and outputs FieldOutput
    fin = c4d.FieldInput()
    fin.SetPoint(wpos)
    fout = c4d.FieldOutput()
    # Strength channel index is typically 0
    fld.Sample(doc, op, None, fin, fout, 1.0)
    val = fout.GetValue() * FALLOFF_MULT
    # Clamp 0..1
    if val < 0.0: val = 0.0
    if val > 1.0: val = 1.0
    return val

# Build triangles from a C4D polygon object (quads->two tris, ngons ignored)
def mesh_to_triangles(op_in):
    points = op_in.GetAllPoints()
    polys = op_in.GetAllPolygons()
    tris = []  # list of (i0,i1,i2)
    for p in polys:
        if p.c == p.d:  # triangle
            tris.append((p.a, p.b, p.c))
        else:  # quad -> split into two triangles (a,b,c) and (a,c,d)
            tris.append((p.a, p.b, p.c))
            tris.append((p.a, p.c, p.d))
    return points, tris

# Subdivide one triangle if avg weight exceeds threshold
# Returns a list of triangles in local index space for the current working mesh

def subdivide_tri(points, tri, wfunc):
    i0, i1, i2 = tri
    p0, p1, p2 = points[i0], points[i1], points[i2]

    # Sample weights at vertices
    w0 = wfunc(p0)
    w1 = wfunc(p1)
    w2 = wfunc(p2)
    w_avg = (w0 + w1 + w2) / 3.0

    if w_avg < THRESHOLD:
        return [tri], points  # no change

    # Midpoints and create new vertices
    m01 = (p0 + p1) * 0.5
    m12 = (p1 + p2) * 0.5
    m20 = (p2 + p0) * 0.5

    i01 = len(points); points.append(m01)
    i12 = len(points); points.append(m12)
    i20 = len(points); points.append(m20)

    # 4 new tris from regular 1-4 split
    return [
        (i0,  i01, i20),
        (i01, i1,  i12),
        (i20, i12, i2),
        (i01, i12, i20)
    ], points

# Recursively apply subdivision to a triangle list

def recursive_subdivide(points, tris, depth, wfunc):
    if depth <= 0:
        return points, tris

    new_tris = []
    for tri in tris:
        out_tris, points = subdivide_tri(points, tri, wfunc)
        new_tris.extend(out_tris)

    # Next level
    return recursive_subdivide(points, new_tris, depth - 1, wfunc)

# Build a PolygonObject from points (list of c4d.Vector) and triangles

def build_poly_object(points, tris):
    cnt_p = len(points)
    cnt_tri = len(tris)
    obj = c4d.PolygonObject(cnt_p, cnt_tri)
    if obj is None:
        return None
    obj.SetAllPoints(points)
    # Create triangles as c4d.CPolygon(a,b,c,c) with d=c
    poly_arr = []
    for (a,b,c) in tris:
        poly_arr.append(c4d.CPolygon(a,b,c,c))
    obj.SetAllPolygons(poly_arr)
    obj.Message(c4d.MSG_UPDATE)
    return obj

def ModifyObject(op, doc, obj, deform_cache, flags, t):
    # obj: original object to be deformed (PolygonObject)
    # We will output a brand-new cache object with subdivided triangles

        return None

    # Get global matrices
    obj_mg = obj.GetMg()
    obj_mg_inv = ~obj_mg

    # Access field list
    fld = get_field_list(op)

    # Prepare points and triangles in object space
    src_points, src_tris = mesh_to_triangles(obj)
    # Convert to mutable list
    pts = [c4d.Vector(p) for p in src_points]

    # Weight sampling function expects world positions
    def wfunc(p_local):
        p_world = obj_mg * p_local
        return sample_field_weight(doc, op, fld, p_world)

    # Apply recursive subdivision
    pts_out, tris_out = recursive_subdivide(pts, list(src_tris), MAX_DEPTH, wfunc)

    # Build new object in object space and then place under same matrix
    out_obj = build_poly_object(pts_out, tris_out)
    if out_obj is None:
        return None

    # Ensure cache object inherits same global matrix as original
    out_obj.SetMg(obj_mg)

    return out_obj

from __future__ import annotations
import random
import math
import c4d
from c4d import plugins, utils
import maxon
from c4d.modules import mograph as mo

# Parameter IDs for the deformer’s Attribute Manager
# Use a private ID space for our parameters in the Python Deformer
PID_MAX_SUBDIV = 1000
PID_STRENGTH_SCALE = 1001
PID_RADIUS_LINK = 1002
PID_SEED = 1003

def AddParam(desc, pid, dtype, name, minv=None, maxv=None, step=None, default=None, anim=True):
    bc = c4d.GetCustomDatatypeDefault(dtype) if dtype != c4d.DTYPE_LONG and dtype != c4d.DTYPE_REAL else c4d.BaseContainer()
    if dtype == c4d.DTYPE_LONG:
        bc = c4d.GetCustomDatatypeDefault(c4d.DTYPE_LONG)
        if minv is not None: bc[c4d.DESC_MIN] = int(minv)
        if maxv is not None: bc[c4d.DESC_MAX] = int(maxv)
        if step is not None: bc[c4d.DESC_STEP] = int(step)
        if default is not None: bc[c4d.DESC_DEFAULT] = int(default)
    elif dtype == c4d.DTYPE_REAL:
        bc = c4d.GetCustomDatatypeDefault(c4d.DTYPE_REAL)
        if minv is not None: bc[c4d.DESC_MIN] = float(minv)
        if maxv is not None: bc[c4d.DESC_MAX] = float(maxv)
        if step is not None: bc[c4d.DESC_STEP] = float(step)
        if default is not None: bc[c4d.DESC_DEFAULT] = float(default)
    else:
        if default is not None: bc[c4d.DESC_DEFAULT] = default

    bc[c4d.DESC_NAME] = name
    bc[c4d.DESC_ANIMATE] = c4d.DESC_ANIMATE_ON if anim else c4d.DESC_ANIMATE_OFF
    singleid = c4d.DescID(c4d.DescLevel(pid, dtype, 0))
    desc.Insert(singleid, bc, c4d.DescID())

class PythonDeformer(plugins.ObjectData):
    def __init__(self):
        self.InitAttr(None)

    def InitAttr(self, op):
        pass

    def Init(self, op):
        # Defaults
        op[c4d.ID_BASEOBJECT_REL_SCALE] = c4d.Vector(1,1,1)
        if op[PID_MAX_SUBDIV] is None:
            op[PID_MAX_SUBDIV] = 3
        if op[PID_STRENGTH_SCALE] is None:
            op[PID_STRENGTH_SCALE] = 1.0
        if op[PID_SEED] is None:
            op[PID_SEED] = 12345
        return True

    def GetDDescription(self, op, description, flags):
        if not description.LoadDescription(op.GetType()):
            return False

        # Group
        groupId = 2000
        AddParam(description, groupId, c4d.DTYPE_GROUP, "Subdivision Control", anim=False)

        # Parameters
        AddParam(description, PID_MAX_SUBDIV, c4d.DTYPE_LONG, "Max Subdivisions", minv=0, maxv=20, step=1, default=3)
        AddParam(description, PID_STRENGTH_SCALE, c4d.DTYPE_REAL, "Strength Scale", minv=0.0, maxv=1000.0, step=0.01, default=1.0)
        AddParam(description, PID_RADIUS_LINK, c4d.DTYPE_BASELISTLINK, "Radius Link", default=None, anim=False)
        AddParam(description, PID_SEED, c4d.DTYPE_LONG, "Seed", minv=0, maxv=10_000_000, step=1, default=12345)

        flags |= c4d.DESCFLAGS_DESC_LOADED
        return True

    def Message(self, op, type, data):
        return True

    def _get_field_strengths(self, op: c4d.BaseObject, md: c4d.BaseObject, doc: c4d.documents.BaseDocument, points: list[c4d.Vector]) -> list[float]:
            # md is the object being deformed (source polygon object)
            # Sample the deformer’s own Fields tab via the FieldList
            fld: mo.FieldList = op.GetFieldList(doc)
            if not fld:
                return [0.0] * len(points)

            # Prepare FieldInfo context
            finfo = mo.FieldInfo()
            finfo.Init(md)  # context object
            # We will sample positions in world space for fields
            mg = md.GetMg()  # object world matrix
            samples = [mg * p for p in points]

            arr = maxon.BaseArray[maxon.Vector]()
            arr.Resize(len(samples))
            for i, v in enumerate(samples):
                arr[i] = maxon.Vector(v.x, v.y, v.z)

            # Evaluate fields, returning normalized strength 0..1 per sample
            # MoGraph FieldList.Evaluate allows sampling arrays efficiently
            # Flags: default 0; we only need strength
            result = fld.Evaluate(arr, finfo, 0)
            # Convert maxon arrays back to Python floats
            strengths = [float(result.strength[i]) for i in range(len(samples))]
            return strengths

    def _build_topology(self, polyObj: c4d.PolygonObject):
        # Build neighbor and adjacency for Laplacian smoothing
        polyObj.Message(c4d.MSG_UPDATE)
        nbr = c4d.utils.Neighbor()
        nbr.Init(polyObj)
        polys = polyObj.GetAllPolygons()
        pcount = polyObj.GetPointCount()

        # For each point, collect connected points (unique)
        neighbors = [set() for _ in range(pcount)]
        for pid, poly in enumerate(polys):
            # poly can be tri or quad
            idx = [poly.a, poly.b, poly.c]
            if not poly.IsTriangle():
                idx.append(poly.d)
            n = len(idx)
            for i in range(n):
                a = idx[i]
                b = idx[(i+1) % n]
                neighbors[a].add(b)
                neighbors[b].add(a)

        # Convert to lists
        neighbor_lists = [list(s) for s in neighbors]
        return neighbor_lists

    def _laplacian_step(self, pts, neighbors, alpha=1.0, seed=0):
        # One pass Laplacian smoothing/displacement
        # alpha: blend toward the neighbor average (0=no change, 1=full average)
        # Add a tiny seeded jitter to reduce lock-ups on symmetrical meshes
        rnd = random.Random(seed)
        new_pts = [c4d.Vector(p) for p in pts]
        for i, p in enumerate(pts):
            nb = neighbors[i]
            if not nb:
                continue
            avg = c4d.Vector(0)
            for j in nb:
                avg += pts[j]
            avg /= len(nb)
            # displacement
            delta = avg - p
            # small jitter, scaled by edge magnitude
            jitter = (rnd.random()-0.5) * 0.01
            new_pts[i] = p + delta * alpha + delta.GetNormalized() * (delta.GetLength() * jitter if delta.GetLength() > 0.0 else 0.0)
        return new_pts

    def _per_point_iterations(self, strengths, maxSteps, scale):
        # Map field strength (0..1) * scale => integer iteration 0..maxSteps (clamped)
        steps = []
        for s in strengths:
            v = max(0.0, min(1.0, s * scale))
            steps.append(int(round(v * maxSteps)))
        return steps

    def _smooth_adaptively(self, pts, neighbors, steps_per_point, seed):
        # Adaptive recursive smoothing: do up to max(steps) passes,
        # but only update points that still have remaining steps at each pass.
        maxSteps = max(steps_per_point) if steps_per_point else 0
        if maxSteps <= 0:
            return pts

        cur = [c4d.Vector(p) for p in pts]
        # Precompute alphas per step: stronger early, softer later (optional taste)
        # Example: alpha_k = 1.0 for all; or decay
        alphas = [1.0 for _ in range(maxSteps)]
        for k in range(maxSteps):
            # Build a step-specific copy and only advance points that still need steps
            nxt = [c4d.Vector(p) for p in cur]
            rnd_seed = seed + k * 101
            # Compute the laplacian for all, but apply selectively
            tmp = self._laplacian_step(cur, neighbors, alpha=alphas[k], seed=rnd_seed)
            for i in range(len(cur)):
                if steps_per_point[i] > k:
                    nxt[i] = tmp[i]
            cur = nxt
        return cur

    def ModifyObject(self, op, doc, obj, flags, thread):
        # obj is the source object being deformed (polygon object)
        if not isinstance(obj, c4d.PolygonObject):
            return True

        # Read parameters
        max_subdiv = int(op[PID_MAX_SUBDIV] or 0)
        strength_scale = float(op[PID_STRENGTH_SCALE] or 1.0)
        seed = int(op[PID_SEED] or 0)

        # Get points (local space)
        pts = list(obj.GetAllPoints())
        if not pts:
            return True

        # Build adjacency once per call (cache could be added with a dirty check)
        neighbors = self._build_topology(obj)

        # Sample field strengths (0..1) in world space then mapped back
        strengths = self._get_field_strengths(op, obj, doc, pts)

        # Map to per-point recursion steps
        steps_per_point = self._per_point_iterations(strengths, max_subdiv, strength_scale)

        # Adaptive recursive smoothing
        new_pts = self._smooth_adaptively(pts, neighbors, steps_per_point, seed)

        # Write back modified points
        obj.SetAllPoints(new_pts)
        obj.Message(c4d.MSG_UPDATE)
        return True

# Register the Python Deformer as an Object Plugin subtype Deformer
PLUGIN_ID = 10698765  # Replace with a unique ID from Plugincafe for production
def Register():
    return plugins.RegisterObjectPlugin(
        id=PLUGIN_ID,
        str="Recursive Field Subdivision (Python)",
        g=PythonDeformer,
        description="",
        icon=None,
        info=c4d.OBJECT_MODIFIER | c4d.OBJECT_DEFORMER
    )

How it works, practically
- Field sampling: The deformer samples its own Field List (Fields tab) using mograph.FieldList. You don’t have to reference the Spherical Field directly; just make sure it’s inside the Python Deformer’s Fields list. The optional Radius Link parameter is provided for convenience (e.g., for expressions/Xpresso or to remind which field is intended).
- Mapping: strength(0..1) * Strength Scale => clamped [0..1] => multiplied by Max Subdivisions => rounded to an integer number of passes at each vertex.
- Recursive smoothing: The script applies Laplacian-like smoothing in multiple passes but only to vertices that still “have steps left” according to the field. Vertices outside the field will remain unchanged; those in the center of a strong field will get more passes.

Exact application steps on any polygon object
1) Convert your object to editable polygons (C or Mesh > Conversion > Make Editable). Ensure it’s not a generator.
2) Make the Python Deformer a child of that polygon object in the Object Manager.
3) In the Python Deformer:
   - Deformer tab: choose Inside or Within Box and scale/position the deformer’s bounding box as desired.
   - Fields tab: add a Spherical Field (adjust Radius and falloff). Keep it enabled.
   - Basic/User Data (the script’s parameters):
     - Max Subdivisions: start with 2–4.
     - Strength Scale: start at 1.0; raise if the effect feels weak (e.g., 2–5); lower if too strong.
     - Radius Link: drag the Spherical Field here (optional).
     - Seed: change if you see repetitive patterns or want a slightly different micro-distribution.
4) Scrub the timeline or nudge parameters to refresh if needed. The effect is procedural and updates live.

Tips and troubleshooting
- No visible effect: Ensure the deformer’s bounding box overlaps the mesh (Inside/Within Box modes), the Spherical Field is in the deformer’s Fields list and active, and Max Subdivisions > 0, Strength Scale > 0.
- Too slow: Reduce Max Subdivisions and/or mesh density; consider disabling HQ viewport modes. You can also limit the Spherical Field size.
- Soft boundaries: Increase Field remapping contrast or reduce Field falloff for sharper transitions.
- Over-smoothing: Lower Strength Scale or reduce Max Subdivisions.
- Scale mismatch: Increase the Spherical Field Radius or Strength Scale to compensate for large scene units; do the opposite for very small scenes.

Why “recursive subdivision” is emulated here
- A true recursive subdivision operation splits faces and increases topology. Deformers in C4D are point modifiers; they cannot add or remove points/polys.
- The provided method applies multiple localized smoothing iterations driven per-vertex by a Field. Visually this approximates the effect of more finely subdivided geometry in the affected area, especially when combined with pre-tessellated meshes.

Optional enhancements you can add
- Cache neighbor topology and only rebuild when the object becomes dirty (performance).
- Normals-preserving smoothing (Taubin-style, alternating lambda/mu).
- Edge-preserve weights based on edge lengths or angles.
- Use the linked Spherical Field’s radius to auto-scale Strength Scale.

# Python tag/deformer entry points
import c4d
from c4d import utils

# Parameter IDs (user data on the deformer for control)
# We will auto-create user data on first run for convenience.
UD_ITERATIONS  = 1
UD_STRENGTH    = 2
UD_RADIUS      = 3
UD_FIELD_LINK  = 4
UD_USE_RADIUS  = 5


def EnsureUserData(op):
    def add_ud_float(obj, name, default, minv, maxv, step=0.01):
        bc = c4d.GetCustomDatatypeDefault(c4d.DTYPE_REAL)
        bc[c4d.DESC_NAME] = name
        bc[c4d.DESC_MIN] = minv
        bc[c4d.DESC_MAX] = maxv
        bc[c4d.DESC_STEP] = step
        return obj.AddUserData(bc), default

    def add_ud_int(obj, name, default, minv, maxv, step=1):
        bc = c4d.GetCustomDatatypeDefault(c4d.DTYPE_LONG)
        bc[c4d.DESC_NAME] = name
        bc[c4d.DESC_MIN] = minv
        bc[c4d.DESC_MAX] = maxv
        bc[c4d.DESC_STEP] = step
        return obj.AddUserData(bc), default

    def add_ud_bool(obj, name, default):
        bc = c4d.GetCustomDatatypeDefault(c4d.DTYPE_BOOL)
        bc[c4d.DESC_NAME] = name
        return obj.AddUserData(bc), default

    def add_ud_link(obj, name):
        bc = c4d.GetCustomDatatypeDefault(c4d.DTYPE_BASELISTLINK)
        bc[c4d.DESC_NAME] = name
        bc[c4d.DESC_ANIMATE] = c4d.DESC_ANIMATE_OFF
        return obj.AddUserData(bc), None

    # Only create once (if first UD is missing)
    if op is None:
        return
    if op.GetUserDataContainer():
        return

    did, val = add_ud_int(op, "Iterations", 2, 0, 8)
    op[did] = val
    did, val = add_ud_float(op, "Strength", 1.0, 0.0, 2.0, 0.01)
    op[did] = val
    did, val = add_ud_float(op, "Max Radius (cm)", 200.0, 0.0, 100000.0, 1.0)
    op[did] = val
    did, _   = add_ud_link(op, "Spherical Field")
    did, val = add_ud_bool(op, "Use Radius Falloff", True)
    op[did] = val


def GetUD(op):
    # Map by order created above
    udc = op.GetUserDataContainer()
    vals = {"iterations": 2, "strength": 1.0, "radius": 200.0, "field": None, "use_radius": True}
    if not udc:
        return vals
    # Resolve by index that matches creation order
    try:
        vals["iterations"] = max(0, int(op[udc[0][0]]))
        vals["strength"]   = float(op[udc[1][0]])
        vals["radius"]     = float(op[udc[2][0]])
        vals["field"]      = op[udc[3][0]]
        vals["use_radius"] = bool(op[udc[4][0]])
    except Exception:
        pass
    return vals


def BuildNeighbor(polyObj):
    nbr = utils.Neighbor()
    nbr.Init(polyObj)
    return nbr


def GetPointNeighbors(nbr, polyObj):
    # Build adjacency list: for each point, set of connected points
    pcnt = polyObj.GetPointCount()
    adj = [set() for _ in range(pcnt)]
    polys = polyObj.GetAllPolygons()
    for i, p in enumerate(polys):
        ids = [p.a, p.b, p.c]
        if not p.IsTriangle():
            ids.append(p.d)
        for a in range(len(ids)):
            for b in range(a+1, len(ids)):
                pa, pb = ids[a], ids[b]
                if 0 <= pa < pcnt and 0 <= pb < pcnt:
                    adj[pa].add(pb)
                    adj[pb].add(pa)
    return adj


def SampleFieldStrength(doc, deformer, fieldObj, worldPos):
    # Use FieldList sampling API via a temporary FieldLayer
    if fieldObj is None:
        return 0.0

    fldList = c4d.modules.mograph.FieldList()
    fldList.Init(doc, deformer)  # context object is the deformer
    fldLayer = c4d.modules.mograph.FieldLayer(fieldObj)
    fldList.InsertLayer(fldLayer)

    arr = c4d.modules.mograph.FieldInput(1)
    arr.SetPoint(0, worldPos)
    res = c4d.modules.mograph.FieldOutput()

    c4d.modules.mograph.FieldEvaluate(fldList, arr, res, c4d.modules.mograph.FIELDSAMPLE_FLAG_VALUE)
    val = res.GetValue(0)

    # Clean up
    fldList.Flush()
    return float(max(0.0, min(1.0, val)))


def Deform(op, doc, obj, mod, lod, flags, thread):
    # Called by C4D for Python Deformer
    if obj is None or not obj.IsInstanceOf(c4d.Opolygon):
        return True

    EnsureUserData(op)
    ud = GetUD(op)

    # Read original points
    pts = obj.GetAllPoints()
    pcnt = len(pts)
    if pcnt == 0:
        return True

    # Prepare adjacency once
    nbr = BuildNeighbor(obj)
    adj = GetPointNeighbors(nbr, obj)

    # World matrices
    mg_obj = obj.GetMg()
    mg_obj_inv = ~mg_obj

    # Work buffer (start from original points)
    work = list(pts)

    iterations = max(0, int(ud["iterations"]))
    baseStrength = max(0.0, float(ud["strength"]))
    maxRadius = max(0.0, float(ud["radius"]))
    fieldObj = ud["field"] if isinstance(ud["field"], c4d.BaseObject) else None
    useRadius = bool(ud["use_radius"]) and maxRadius > 0.0

    # Precompute neighbor averages per iteration
    for it in range(iterations):
        newPts = list(work)
        for i in range(pcnt):
            nbs = adj[i]
            if not nbs:
                continue

            # Average of neighbors in object space
            avg = c4d.Vector(0)
            cnt = 0
            for j in nbs:
                avg += work[j]
                cnt += 1
            if cnt == 0:
                continue
            avg /= float(cnt)

            # Field-driven weight
            w = 1.0
            if fieldObj is not None:
                wp = mg_obj * work[i]
                w = SampleFieldStrength(doc, op, fieldObj, wp)

            # Optional radial falloff from field object position (assumes spherical field)
            if useRadius and fieldObj is not None:
                center = fieldObj.GetMg().off
                dist = (mg_obj * work[i] - center).GetLength()
                if dist >= maxRadius:
                    w *= 0.0
                else:
                    # Smoothstep falloff inside radius
                    t = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - dist / maxRadius))
                    w *= (t * t * (3 - 2 * t))

            strength = baseStrength * w
            if strength <= 0.0:
                continue

            # Move point toward neighbor average (Laplace-like smoothing)
            p = work[i]
            newPts[i] = p + (avg - p) * strength
        work = newPts

    # Write back
    obj.SetAllPoints(work)
    obj.Message(c4d.MSG_UPDATE)
    return True

   - Iterations: recursion depth of the smoothing/subdivision-like pass (0–8 recommended).

- Topology is not changed; this is a displacement-style recursive smoothing influenced by a Field. Use Subdivision Surface for actual mesh refinement.

- If you don’t link a field, Strength applies uniformly. If you do, the field controls where the recursion applies.

Alternative built-in methods:

  - Rotation from orbital plane to ecliptic J2000:

- Units:

Precision, performance, and date/time challenges with mitigations
- Precision limits:

  - Mitigation: Offer HORIZONS-sampled mode for validation; display an “accuracy” note and optionally show residuals between Kepler and HORIZONS.
- Time scales and ΔT:
  - UTC vs TT/TDB introduces seconds-level differences; for visualization, an approximate ΔT is acceptable.

- Floating-point and scaling:
  - Large vs small scales on canvas can cause jitter at extreme zoom.
  - Mitigation: Use double precision (JS Number), keep world units in AU near 1, and apply pan/zoom via matrix before rasterization; avoid repeatedly adding small deltas to large values (accumulated error).
- Performance with labels/orbits:
  - Many path segments and frequent text layout can drop FPS.
  - Mitigation: Precompute orbit polylines; draw labels on separate overlay; throttle label redraw; use requestAnimationFrame and avoid synchronous layout thrash.
- Event handling and responsiveness:
  - Wheel/touch events can be noisy.
  - Mitigation: Debounce zoom/pan updates to reduce redraw workload; use passive listeners where appropriate.
- Canvas resolution and DPI:
  - High-DPI displays require larger backing store sizes.
  - Mitigation: Detect devicePixelRatio and scale canvas accordingly; cap to reasonable limits to prevent memory bloat.

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# yt_chatbot.py
# End-to-end: YouTube transcript ingestion -> preprocessing -> training -> chat.
# Comply with YouTube’s ToS. Fetch only publicly available transcripts.

import os
import re
import json
import argparse
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Tuple

from tqdm import tqdm

# YouTube API + transcript
from googleapiclient.discovery import build
from youtube_transcript_api import (
    YouTubeTranscriptApi,
    TranscriptsDisabled,
    NoTranscriptFound,
    VideoUnavailable
)

# ML and NLP stack
import torch
from datasets import Dataset, DatasetDict
from transformers import (
    AutoTokenizer,
    AutoModelForCausalLM,
    DataCollatorForLanguageModeling,
    Trainer,
    TrainingArguments,
    set_seed
)

# -----------------------------
# Configuration helpers
# -----------------------------
SPECIAL_TOKENS = ["<|user|>", "<|assistant|>", "<|end|>"]
DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME = "distilgpt2"
# DistilGPT2 (pretrained): 6 decoder layers, 12 heads, hidden size 768 (~82M params).
# Loss: Causal LM (token-level CrossEntropyLoss with labels shifted by one)
# Optimizer: AdamW (via Trainer with optim="adamw_torch")

# -----------------------------
# YouTube data ingestion
# -----------------------------
def search_youtube_videos(api_key: str, query: str, max_videos: int = 10, region_code: str = "US") -> List[str]:
    """
    Search YouTube for videos using the official YouTube Data API v3.
    Returns a list of video IDs.
    """
    youtube = build("youtube", "v3", developerKey=api_key)
    video_ids = []
    max_results = min(max_videos, 50)
    request = youtube.search().list(
        q=query,
        part="id",
        type="video",
        maxResults=max_results,
        regionCode=region_code,
        safeSearch="moderate"
    )
    response = request.execute()
    for item in response.get("items", []):
        vid = item["id"]["videoId"]
        video_ids.append(vid)
        if len(video_ids) >= max_videos:
            break
    return video_ids


def fetch_transcript_for_video(video_id: str, languages: List[str]) -> str:
    """
    Try to fetch the transcript for a given video, returns the text (joined).
    If not available, returns empty string.
    """
    # Attempt direct transcript fetch for preferred languages first
    try:
        transcript = YouTubeTranscriptApi.get_transcript(video_id, languages=languages)
        text = " ".join([chunk["text"] for chunk in transcript if chunk["text"].strip()])
        return text
    except (TranscriptsDisabled, NoTranscriptFound, VideoUnavailable):
        pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Fallback: list transcripts and fetch any available (prefer manual if possible)
    try:
        transcripts_list = YouTubeTranscriptApi.list_transcripts(video_id)
        chosen = None
        # Prefer a manually created English transcript if available
        for t in transcripts_list:
            try:
                lang = getattr(t, "language_code", None)
                if getattr(t, "is_generated", True) is False and (lang in languages or (lang and lang.startswith("en"))):
                    chosen = t
                    break
            except Exception:
                continue
        # If none chosen, pick the first available transcript
        if chosen is None:
            for t in transcripts_list:
                chosen = t
                break
        if chosen is not None:
            fetched = chosen.fetch()
            text = " ".join([chunk["text"] for chunk in fetched if chunk["text"].strip()])
            return text
    except (TranscriptsDisabled, NoTranscriptFound, VideoUnavailable):
        return ""
    except Exception:
        return ""

    return ""

# -----------------------------
# Text preprocessing
# -----------------------------
def clean_transcript_text(text: str) -> str:
    """
    Basic cleanup: remove stage directions, URLs, repeated spaces.
    """
    # Remove bracketed tags like [Music], (Applause)
    text = re.sub(r"\[.*?\]|\(.*?\)", " ", text)
    # Remove URLs
    text = re.sub(r"http[s]?://\S+|www\.\S+", " ", text)
    # Remove timestamps like 00:12 or 0:12:34
    text = re.sub(r"\b\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?\b", " ", text)
    # Collapse whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text


def transcript_to_utterances(text: str, min_len: int = 3, max_len: int = 200) -> List[str]:
    """
    Split transcript into simple utterances by sentence-like boundaries.
    min_len/max_len are character-based heuristics.
    """
    if not text:
        return []

    # Split on sentence enders or newlines
    parts = re.split(r"(?<=[\.|\?|\!])\s+|\n+", text)
    # Filter and normalize
    utterances = []
    for p in parts:
        p = p.strip()
        if len(p) < min_len:
            continue
        if len(p) > max_len:
            # If too long, chunk into smaller sentences by commas
            chunks = re.split(r",\s+", p)
            for c in chunks:
                c = c.strip()
                if min_len <= len(c) <= max_len:
                    utterances.append(c)
        else:
            utterances.append(p)

    # Remove duplicates and overly repetitive lines
    seen = set()
    unique_utts = []
    for u in utterances:
        key = u.lower()
        if key not in seen:
            unique_utts.append(u)
            seen.add(key)
    return unique_utts


def build_dialogues_from_utterances(
    utterances: List[str],
    max_turns: int = 8,
    stride: int = 8
) -> List[str]:
    """
    Build synthetic multi-turn dialogues by alternating user/assistant turns.
    Returns a list of dialogue strings with special tokens.
    Each dialogue is formatted as:
      <|user|> ... <|end|><|assistant|> ... <|end|><|user|> ... <|end|>...
    """
    dialogues = []
    if not utterances:
        return dialogues

    for start in range(0, len(utterances), stride):
        window = utterances[start:start + max_turns]
        if len(window) < 2:
            continue
        turns = []
        # Alternate roles: user, assistant, user, assistant, ...
        for i, utt in enumerate(window):
            role_token = "<|user|>" if i % 2 == 0 else "<|assistant|>"
            turns.append(f"{role_token} {utt} <|end|>")
        dialogue = "".join(turns)
        dialogues.append(dialogue)
    return dialogues

# -----------------------------
# Dataset and training utilities
# -----------------------------
def save_dialogues_jsonl(dialogues: List[str], out_path: str) -> None:
    """
    Save dialogues to a JSONL file with fields: id, text.
    """
    dirpath = os.path.dirname(out_path)
    if dirpath and not os.path.exists(dirpath):
        os.makedirs(dirpath, exist_ok=True)
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for i, d in enumerate(dialogues):
            rec = {"id": i, "text": d}
            f.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def load_dialogues_jsonl(path: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    rows = []
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                obj = json.loads(line)
                if "text" in obj:
                    rows.append({"text": obj["text"]})
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
    return rows


def ensure_tokenizer_special_tokens(tokenizer: AutoTokenizer, model: AutoModelForCausalLM) -> None:
    """
    Ensure special tokens exist and resize model embeddings accordingly.
    Also sets pad_token if missing (GPT-2 family lacks pad_token by default).
    """
    added = False

    # Add additional special tokens
    existing_additional = tokenizer.additional_special_tokens or []
    to_add = [t for t in SPECIAL_TOKENS if t not in existing_additional]
    if to_add:
        tokenizer.add_special_tokens({"additional_special_tokens": existing_additional + to_add})
        added = True

    # Ensure pad_token exists (for batching). Use eos_token as pad if none.
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        if tokenizer.eos_token is not None:
            tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
        else:
            tokenizer.add_special_tokens({"pad_token": "<|pad|>"})
            added = True

    if added:
        model.resize_token_embeddings(len(tokenizer))


def tokenize_dialogues(examples: Dict[str, List[str]], tokenizer: AutoTokenizer, block_size: int = 512) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    texts = examples["text"]
    return tokenizer(
        texts,
        max_length=block_size,
        truncation=True,
        padding=False,
        return_tensors=None
    )


def prepare_datasets(data_path: str, tokenizer: AutoTokenizer, block_size: int = 512, val_ratio: float = 0.1) -> DatasetDict:
    rows = load_dialogues_jsonl(data_path)
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError(f"No data found in {data_path} or file is empty.")
    ds = Dataset.from_list(rows)
    # Simple train/val split
    n = len(ds)
    val_size = max(1, int(n * val_ratio)) if n > 10 else max(1, n // 5)
    split = ds.train_test_split(test_size=val_size, seed=42)
    tokenized = split.map(lambda x: tokenize_dialogues(x, tokenizer, block_size), batched=True, remove_columns=["text"])
    return DatasetDict(train=tokenized["train"], test=tokenized["test"])  # test used as validation


# -----------------------------
# Training and evaluation
# -----------------------------
def train_model(
    data_path: str,
    output_dir: str,
    model_name: str = DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME,
    epochs: int = 1,
    batch_size: int = 2,
    lr: float = 5e-5,
    seed: int = 42,
    block_size: int = 512
) -> Tuple[AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM]:
    if not os.path.isfile(data_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Data file not found: {data_path}")
    if epochs <= 0:
        raise ValueError("epochs must be > 0")
    if batch_size <= 0:
        raise ValueError("batch_size must be > 0")

    set_seed(seed)

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name, use_fast=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_name)

    ensure_tokenizer_special_tokens(tokenizer, model)

    datasets_dd = prepare_datasets(data_path, tokenizer, block_size=block_size)

    data_collator = DataCollatorForLanguageModeling(tokenizer=tokenizer, mlm=False)

    training_args = TrainingArguments(
        output_dir=output_dir,
        overwrite_output_dir=True,
        per_device_train_batch_size=batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=batch_size,
        evaluation_strategy="steps",
        eval_steps=200,
        logging_steps=50,
        save_steps=200,
        num_train_epochs=epochs,
        learning_rate=lr,
        weight_decay=0.01,
        warmup_ratio=0.03,
        lr_scheduler_type="linear",
        save_total_limit=2,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=1,
        bf16=torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0)[0] >= 8,
        fp16=not torch.cuda.is_available(),
        report_to=[],
    )

    trainer = Trainer(
        model=model,
        args=training_args,
        train_dataset=datasets_dd["train"],
        eval_dataset=datasets_dd["test"],
        data_collator=data_collator,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
    )

    trainer.train()

    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(output_dir)
    model.save_pretrained(output_dir)

    # Save dataset shards used for training for reproducibility
    datasets_dd["train"].to_json(os.path.join(output_dir, "train.dataset.json"))
    datasets_dd["test"].to_json(os.path.join(output_dir, "val.dataset.json"))

    return tokenizer, model


# -----------------------------
# Inference / chat
# -----------------------------
def load_model(model_dir: str) -> Tuple[AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM]:
    if not os.path.isdir(model_dir):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Model directory not found: {model_dir}")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_dir, use_fast=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_dir)
    ensure_tokenizer_special_tokens(tokenizer, model)
    model.eval()
    return tokenizer, model


def format_dialog_history(history: List[Tuple[str, str]]) -> str:
    """
    history: list of (user_text, assistant_text) for previous turns.
    Returns a single concatenated prompt using special tokens, ending with a new <|user|>.
    """
    parts = []
    for u, a in history:
        if u:
            parts.append(f"<|user|> {u} <|end|>")
        if a:
            parts.append(f"<|assistant|> {a} <|end|>")
    return "".join(parts)


def generate_response(tokenizer, model, history: List[Tuple[str, str]], user_input: str, max_new_tokens: int = 128, temperature: float = 0.7, top_p: float = 0.9, top_k: int = 50) -> str:
    prompt = format_dialog_history(history) + f"<|user|> {user_input} <|end|><|assistant|>"
    inputs = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt")
    input_ids = inputs["input_ids"]
    attention_mask = inputs.get("attention_mask")
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        model = model.to("cuda")
        input_ids = input_ids.to("cuda")
        if attention_mask is not None:
            attention_mask = attention_mask.to("cuda")

    with torch.no_grad():
        output_ids = model.generate(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
            do_sample=True,
            temperature=temperature,
            top_p=top_p,
            top_k=top_k,
            pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
            eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
        )
    gen_text = tokenizer.decode(output_ids[0][input_ids.shape[-1]:], skip_special_tokens=False)

    # Extract assistant segment until next <|end|>
    end_tok = "<|end|>"
    if end_tok in gen_text:
        response = gen_text.split(end_tok, 1)[0].strip()
    else:
        response = gen_text.strip()
    return response


def chat_cli(model_dir: str) -> None:
    tokenizer, model = load_model(model_dir)
    print("Loaded model from:", model_dir)
    print("Type 'exit' to quit. Type 'reset' to clear context.")

    history: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    while True:
        try:
            user_inp = input("You: ").strip()
        except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
            print("\nExiting.")
            break
        if not user_inp:
            continue
        if user_inp.lower() in {"exit", "quit"}:
            print("Goodbye!")
            break
        if user_inp.lower() == "reset":
            history = []
            print("Context cleared.")
            continue
        try:
            reply = generate_response(tokenizer, model, history, user_inp)
            print("Assistant:", reply)
            history.append((user_inp, reply))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error during generation: {e}")


# -----------------------------
# Download pipeline
# -----------------------------
def download_cli(query: str, max_videos: int, out_path: str, languages: Optional[List[str]] = None, api_key_env: str = "YT_API_KEY") -> None:
    if languages is None:
        languages = ["en", "en-US", "en-GB"]
    api_key = os.environ.get(api_key_env)
    if not api_key:
        raise EnvironmentError(f"Missing API key in env var {api_key_env}")

    video_ids = search_youtube_videos(api_key, query, max_videos)

    dialogues_all: List[str] = []
    for vid in tqdm(video_ids, desc="Fetching transcripts"):
        try:
            raw = fetch_transcript_for_video(vid, languages)
        except Exception:
            raw = ""
        if not raw:
            continue
        cleaned = clean_transcript_text(raw)
        utterances = transcript_to_utterances(cleaned)
        dialogues = build_dialogues_from_utterances(utterances)
        dialogues_all.extend(dialogues)

    if not dialogues_all:
        raise RuntimeError("No dialogues created from the fetched transcripts.")

    save_dialogues_jsonl(dialogues_all, out_path)
    print(f"Saved {len(dialogues_all)} dialogues to {out_path}")


# -----------------------------
# CLI wiring
# -----------------------------
def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="YouTube dialogue trainer and chat bot")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p_dl = sub.add_parser("download", help="Download transcripts and build dialogues")
    p_dl.add_argument("--query", required=True, type=str)
    p_dl.add_argument("--max_videos", type=int, default=10)
    p_dl.add_argument("--out", required=True, type=str, help="Output JSONL file for dialogues")

    p_tr = sub.add_parser("train", help="Train model with Trainer")
    p_tr.add_argument("--data", required=True, type=str, help="JSONL dialogues path")
    p_tr.add_argument("--output_dir", required=True, type=str)
    p_tr.add_argument("--model_name", type=str, default=DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME)
    p_tr.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=1)
    p_tr.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=2)
    p_tr.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=5e-5)
    p_tr.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    p_tr.add_argument("--block_size", type=int, default=512)

    p_chat = sub.add_parser("chat", help="Chat with a fine-tuned model")
    p_chat.add_argument("--model_dir", required=True, type=str)

    p_all = sub.add_parser("all", help="Download -> Train -> (optional) Chat")
    p_all.add_argument("--query", required=True, type=str)
    p_all.add_argument("--max_videos", type=int, default=10)
    p_all.add_argument("--output_dir", required=True, type=str)
    p_all.add_argument("--model_name", type=str, default=DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME)
    p_all.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=1)
    p_all.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=2)
    p_all.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=5e-5)
    p_all.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    p_all.add_argument("--block_size", type=int, default=512)
    p_all.add_argument("--chat", action="store_true", help="Enter chat after training")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    try:
        if args.cmd == "download":
            download_cli(args.query, args.max_videos, args.out)
        elif args.cmd == "train":
            train_model(
                data_path=args.data,

                model_name=args.model_name,
                epochs=args.epochs,
                batch_size=args.batch_size,
                lr=args.lr,
                seed=args.seed,
                block_size=args.block_size,
            )
            print(f"Model saved to {args.output_dir}")
        elif args.cmd == "chat":
            chat_cli(args.model_dir)
        elif args.cmd == "all":
            tmp_data = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "dialogues.jsonl")
            os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

                output_dir=args.output_dir,
                model_name=args.model_name,

                batch_size=args.batch_size,
                lr=args.lr,

            )
            print(f"Model saved to {args.output_dir}")

        else:
            parser.error("Unknown command")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# yt_chatbot.py
# End-to-end: YouTube transcript ingestion -> preprocessing -> training -> chat.
# Comply with YouTube’s ToS. Fetch only publicly available transcripts.

import os
import re
import sys
import json
import argparse
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Tuple

from tqdm import tqdm

# YouTube API + transcript
from googleapiclient.discovery import build
from youtube_transcript_api import (
    YouTubeTranscriptApi,
    TranscriptsDisabled,
    NoTranscriptFound,
    VideoUnavailable
)

# ML and NLP stack
import torch
from datasets import Dataset
from transformers import (
    AutoTokenizer,
    AutoModelForCausalLM,
    DataCollatorForLanguageModeling,
    Trainer,
    TrainingArguments,
    set_seed
)

SPECIAL_TOKENS = ["<|user|>", "<|assistant|>", "<|end|>"]
DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME = "distilgpt2"

# -----------------------------
# YouTube data ingestion
# -----------------------------

def search_youtube_videos(api_key: str, query: str, max_videos: int = 10, region_code: str = "US") -> List[str]:
    youtube = build("youtube", "v3", developerKey=api_key)
    video_ids: List[str] = []
    fetched = 0
    next_page_token = None
    while fetched < max_videos:
        to_get = min(50, max_videos - fetched)
        request = youtube.search().list(
            q=query,
            part="id",
            type="video",
            maxResults=to_get,
            regionCode=region_code,
            safeSearch="moderate",
            pageToken=next_page_token
        )
        response = request.execute()
        for item in response.get("items", []):
            vid = item.get("id", {}).get("videoId")
            if vid:
                video_ids.append(vid)
                fetched += 1
                if fetched >= max_videos:
                    break
        next_page_token = response.get("nextPageToken")
        if not next_page_token:
            break
    return video_ids


def fetch_transcript_for_video(video_id: str, languages: List[str]) -> str:
    # Try preferred languages
    try:
        transcript = YouTubeTranscriptApi.get_transcript(video_id, languages=languages)
        return " ".join([c["text"] for c in transcript if c["text"].strip()])
    except (TranscriptsDisabled, NoTranscriptFound, VideoUnavailable):
        pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Fallback: list transcripts and pick a reasonable one
    try:
        transcripts_list = YouTubeTranscriptApi.list_transcripts(video_id)
        chosen = None
        # Prefer manual in preferred languages
        for t in transcripts_list:
            try:
                lang = getattr(t, "language_code", None)
                is_gen = getattr(t, "is_generated", True)
                if (not is_gen) and (lang in languages or (lang and lang.startswith("en"))):
                    chosen = t
                    break
            except Exception:
                continue
        # If none chosen, pick first available
        if chosen is None:
            for t in transcripts_list:
                chosen = t
                break
        if chosen is not None:
            fetched = chosen.fetch()
            return " ".join([c["text"] for c in fetched if c["text"].strip()])
    except (TranscriptsDisabled, NoTranscriptFound, VideoUnavailable):
        return ""
    except Exception:
        return ""
    return ""

# -----------------------------
# Text preprocessing
# -----------------------------

def clean_transcript_text(text: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"\[.*?\]|\(.*?\)", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"http[s]?://\S+|www\.\S+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?\b", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text


def transcript_to_utterances(text: str, min_len: int = 3, max_len: int = 200) -> List[str]:
    if not text:
        return []
    parts = re.split(r"(?<=[\.!\?])\s+|\n+", text)
    utterances: List[str] = []
    for p in parts:
        p = p.strip()
        if len(p) < min_len:
            continue
        if len(p) > max_len:
            chunks = re.split(r",\s+", p)
            for c in chunks:
                c = c.strip()
                if min_len <= len(c) <= max_len:
                    utterances.append(c)
        else:
            utterances.append(p)
    # de-dup
    seen = set()
    unique = []
    for u in utterances:
        k = u.lower()
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            unique.append(u)
    return unique


def build_dialogues_from_utterances(utterances: List[str], max_turns: int = 8, stride: int = 8) -> List[str]:
    dialogues: List[str] = []
    if not utterances:
        return dialogues
    for start in range(0, len(utterances), stride):
        window = utterances[start:start + max_turns]
        if len(window) < 2:
            continue
        turns = []
        for i, utt in enumerate(window):
            role = "<|user|>" if i % 2 == 0 else "<|assistant|>"
            turns.append(f"{role} {utt} <|end|>")
        dialogues.append("".join(turns))
    return dialogues

# -----------------------------
# Dataset I/O
# -----------------------------

def save_dialogues_jsonl(dialogues: List[str], out_path: str) -> None:
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for i, d in enumerate(dialogues):
            f.write(json.dumps({"id": i, "text": d}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def load_dialogues_jsonl(path: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    rows: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                obj = json.loads(line)
                if "text" in obj:
                    rows.append({"text": obj["text"]})
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
    return rows

# -----------------------------
# Tokenizer/model utilities
# -----------------------------

def ensure_tokenizer_special_tokens(tokenizer: AutoTokenizer, model: AutoModelForCausalLM) -> None:
    added = False
    existing = tokenizer.additional_special_tokens or []
    to_add = [t for t in SPECIAL_TOKENS if t not in existing]
    if to_add:
        tokenizer.add_special_tokens({"additional_special_tokens": existing + to_add})
        added = True
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        if tokenizer.eos_token is not None:
            tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
        else:
            tokenizer.add_special_tokens({"pad_token": "<|pad|>"})
            added = True
    if added:
        model.resize_token_embeddings(len(tokenizer))

# -----------------------------
# Dataset preparation for LM
# -----------------------------

def build_hf_dataset_from_jsonl(path: str, tokenizer: AutoTokenizer, block_size: int = 512) -> Dataset:
    rows = load_dialogues_jsonl(path)
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty or invalid JSONL")
    ds = Dataset.from_list(rows)

    def tokenize_fn(batch: Dict[str, List[str]]):
        return tokenizer(batch["text"])  # do not pad here; LM collator will handle

    tokenized = ds.map(tokenize_fn, batched=True, remove_columns=["text"]) 

    # Group texts into blocks
    def group_texts(examples: Dict[str, List[List[int]]]):
        concatenated = {k: sum(examples[k], []) for k in examples.keys()}
        total_length = len(concatenated["input_ids"])
        total_length = (total_length // block_size) * block_size
        result = {k: [t[:total_length]] for k, t in concatenated.items()}
        result = {k: [
            sum([result[k][0][i:i+block_size] for i in range(0, total_length, block_size)], [])
        ] for k in result}
        # Now split into chunks
        def chunk(lst: List[int], n: int) -> List[List[int]]:
            return [lst[i:i+n] for i in range(0, len(lst), n)]
        return {
            "input_ids": chunk(result["input_ids"][0], block_size),
            "attention_mask": chunk(result["attention_mask"][0], block_size),
        }

    tokenized = tokenized.map(group_texts, batched=True)

    # Labels are input_ids shifted by the model internally for CausalLM; duplicate input_ids
    tokenized = tokenized.map(lambda e: {"labels": e["input_ids"]}, batched=True)
    return tokenized

# -----------------------------
# Training routine
# -----------------------------

def train_model(data_path: str, output_dir: str, model_name: str = DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME, epochs: int = 1, batch_size: int = 2, lr: float = 5e-5, seed: int = 42) -> None:
    if not os.path.isfile(data_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Data file not found: {data_path}")
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    set_seed(seed)

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name, use_fast=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_name)
    ensure_tokenizer_special_tokens(tokenizer, model)

    ds = build_hf_dataset_from_jsonl(data_path, tokenizer)
    collator = DataCollatorForLanguageModeling(tokenizer=tokenizer, mlm=False)

    args = TrainingArguments(
        output_dir=output_dir,
        overwrite_output_dir=True,
        num_train_epochs=epochs,
        per_device_train_batch_size=batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=1,
        learning_rate=lr,
        weight_decay=0.01,
        warmup_ratio=0.03,
        logging_steps=20,
        save_steps=200,
        save_total_limit=2,
        fp16=torch.cuda.is_available(),
        dataloader_num_workers=0,
        report_to=[],
    )

    trainer = Trainer(
        model=model,
        args=args,
        train_dataset=ds,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
        data_collator=collator,
    )

    trainer.train()

    # Robust save
    trainer.save_model(output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(output_dir)
    # Save training config
    with open(os.path.join(output_dir, "training_meta.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({
            "model_name": model_name,
            "epochs": epochs,
            "batch_size": batch_size,
            "lr": lr,
            "seed": seed,
            "special_tokens": SPECIAL_TOKENS,
        }, f, indent=2)

# -----------------------------
# Chat routine
# -----------------------------

@dataclass
class ChatConfig:
    max_new_tokens: int = 128
    temperature: float = 0.8
    top_p: float = 0.9
    repetition_penalty: float = 1.05


def load_model_tokenizer(model_dir: str) -> Tuple[AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer]:
    if not os.path.isdir(model_dir):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Model directory not found: {model_dir}")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_dir, use_fast=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_dir)
    ensure_tokenizer_special_tokens(tokenizer, model)
    model.eval()
    return model, tokenizer


def format_history(history: List[Tuple[str, str]]) -> str:
    # history: list of (user, assistant) turns; last assistant may be empty during generation
    parts = []
    for u, a in history:
        parts.append(f"<|user|> {u} <|end|>")
        if a is not None and a != "":
            parts.append(f"<|assistant|> {a} <|end|>")
    return "".join(parts)


def generate_reply(model: AutoModelForCausalLM, tokenizer: AutoTokenizer, history: List[Tuple[str, str]], cfg: ChatConfig) -> str:
    prompt = format_history(history) + "<|assistant|>"
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    model.to(device)
    inputs = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        output_ids = model.generate(
            **inputs,
            max_new_tokens=cfg.max_new_tokens,
            do_sample=True,
            temperature=cfg.temperature,
            top_p=cfg.top_p,
            repetition_penalty=cfg.repetition_penalty,
            eos_token_id=tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|end|>"),
            pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
        )
    gen_text = tokenizer.decode(output_ids[0][inputs.input_ids.shape[1]:], skip_special_tokens=False)
    # Extract until <|end|>
    end_tok = "<|end|>"
    if end_tok in gen_text:
        gen_text = gen_text.split(end_tok, 1)[0]
    return gen_text.strip()

# -----------------------------
# CLI commands
# -----------------------------

def cmd_download(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    api_key = os.environ.get("YT_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise EnvironmentError("YT_API_KEY environment variable not set")
    if not args.query:
        raise ValueError("--query is required")
    if args.max_videos <= 0:
        raise ValueError("--max_videos must be > 0")

    langs = ["en", "en-US", "en-GB"]
    vids = search_youtube_videos(api_key, args.query, max_videos=args.max_videos, region_code=args.region)

    dialogues: List[str] = []
    for vid in tqdm(vids, desc="Transcripts"):
        try:
            raw = fetch_transcript_for_video(vid, languages=langs)
        except Exception:
            raw = ""
        if not raw:
            continue
        cleaned = clean_transcript_text(raw)
        utts = transcript_to_utterances(cleaned)
        ds = build_dialogues_from_utterances(utts, max_turns=args.max_turns, stride=args.stride)
        dialogues.extend(ds)

    if not dialogues:
        raise RuntimeError("No dialogues were created; try a different query or more videos")

    save_dialogues_jsonl(dialogues, args.out)
    print(f"Saved {len(dialogues)} dialogues to {args.out}")


def cmd_train(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    if not args.data:
        raise ValueError("--data is required")
    if not os.path.isfile(args.data):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Data file not found: {args.data}")
    if not args.output_dir:
        raise ValueError("--output_dir is required")
    if args.epochs <= 0:
        raise ValueError("--epochs must be > 0")
    if args.batch_size <= 0:
        raise ValueError("--batch_size must be > 0")

    train_model(
        data_path=args.data,
        output_dir=args.output_dir,
        model_name=args.model_name or DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME,
        epochs=args.epochs,
        batch_size=args.batch_size,
        lr=args.lr,
        seed=args.seed,
    )


def cmd_chat(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    if not args.model_dir:
        raise ValueError("--model_dir is required")
    model, tokenizer = load_model_tokenizer(args.model_dir)
    cfg = ChatConfig(
        max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
        temperature=args.temperature,
        top_p=args.top_p,
        repetition_penalty=args.repetition_penalty,
    )

    print("Type 'exit' to quit. Starting chat...\n")
    history: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    while True:
        try:
            user_inp = input("You: ").strip()
        except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
            print() ; break
        if user_inp.lower() in {"exit", "quit"}:
            break
        history.append((user_inp, ""))
        reply = generate_reply(model, tokenizer, history, cfg)
        # update last turn with assistant reply
        history[-1] = (history[-1][0], reply)
        print(f"Assistant: {reply}\n")


def cmd_all(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    # Download
    tmp_data = args.data or os.path.join(args.output_dir, "dialogues.jsonl")
    dl_args = argparse.Namespace(
        query=args.query,
        max_videos=args.max_videos,
        out=tmp_data,
        region=args.region,
        max_turns=args.max_turns,
        stride=args.stride,
    )
    cmd_download(dl_args)
    # Train

    # Optional chat
    if args.chat:

            temperature=args.temperature,
            top_p=args.top_p,
            repetition_penalty=args.repetition_penalty,
        )
        cmd_chat(ch_args)

# -----------------------------
# Argument parsing
# -----------------------------

def build_arg_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="YouTube dialogue trainer and chatbot")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    # download
    pd = sub.add_parser("download", help="Download transcripts and build dialogues")
    pd.add_argument("--query", type=str, required=True)
    pd.add_argument("--max_videos", type=int, default=10)
    pd.add_argument("--region", type=str, default="US")
    pd.add_argument("--max_turns", type=int, default=8)
    pd.add_argument("--stride", type=int, default=8)
    pd.add_argument("--out", type=str, required=True)
    pd.set_defaults(func=cmd_download)

    # train
    pt = sub.add_parser("train", help="Fine-tune model with Trainer")
    pt.add_argument("--data", type=str, required=True)
    pt.add_argument("--output_dir", type=str, required=True)

    pc.add_argument("--top_p", type=float, default=0.9)
    pc.add_argument("--repetition_penalty", type=float, default=1.05)
    pc.set_defaults(func=cmd_chat)

    # all-in-one
    pa = sub.add_parser("all", help="Download, train, and optionally chat")
    pa.add_argument("--query", type=str, required=True)
    pa.add_argument("--max_videos", type=int, default=10)
    pa.add_argument("--region", type=str, default="US")
    pa.add_argument("--max_turns", type=int, default=8)
    pa.add_argument("--stride", type=int, default=8)
    pa.add_argument("--data", type=str, default=None, help="Optional path to save dialogues.jsonl")
    pa.add_argument("--output_dir", type=str, required=True)
    pa.add_argument("--model_name", type=str, default=DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME)
    pa.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=1)
    pa.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=2)
    pa.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=5e-5)
    pa.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    pa.add_argument("--chat", action="store_true", help="Launch chat after training")
    pa.add_argument("--max_new_tokens", type=int, default=128)
    pa.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.8)
    pa.add_argument("--top_p", type=float, default=0.9)
    pa.add_argument("--repetition_penalty", type=float, default=1.05)
    pa.set_defaults(func=cmd_all)

    return p


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> None:
    argv = argv if argv is not None else sys.argv[1:]
    parser = build_arg_parser()
```
